title: Analista De Dados Sênior
description:
Analista de Dados SR Modalidade : Remoto Estamos em busca de um Analista de Dados talentoso e motivado para se juntar à nossa equipe. O candidato ideal terá experiência em análise de dados, desenvolvimento de processos ETL e habilidades sólidas em programação com Python, além de conhecimento em SQL e serviços da AWS. O Analista de Dados será responsável por transformar dados brutos em informações valiosas para tomada de decisões estratégicas. Responsabilidades : - Extrair, transformar e carregar (ETL) dados de diversas fontes, garantindo a qualidade e integridade das informações.
- Desenvolver e otimizar scripts em Python para automação de processos e análise de dados.
- Criar e manter consultas SQL para manipulação e extração de dados de bancos relacionais.
- Trabalhar com ferramentas e serviços da AWS para armazenamento, processamento e análise de dados (ex.: Amazon S3, Redshift, Athena).
- Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para entender requisitos de negócios e traduzir em soluções analíticas.
- Produzir relatórios e dashboards que ajudem na visualização e interpretação dos dados.
- Monitorar e melhorar continuamente os processos de dados, propondo soluções inovadoras. Requisitos : - Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas relacionadas.
- Experiência comprovada em programação Python para análise de dados.
- Sólidos conhecimentos em SQL e experiência com bancos de dados relacionais.
- Experiência em processos de ETL e ferramentas relacionadas.
- Familiaridade com serviços da AWS, especialmente em soluções de armazenamento e processamento de dados.
- Habilidade em comunicação e trabalho em equipe.
- Capacidade de resolver problemas de forma criativa e analítica. Diferenciais : - Conhecimento em ferramentas de visualização de dados (ex.: Tableau, Power BI).
- Experiência com Big Data e tecnologias como Hadoop ou Spark.
- Certificações relevantes na área de análise de dados ou AWS.

description:

Familiarity with monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana). Additional Information: CLT employment type;

title: Cloud Ai/Ml Engineer
description:
Looking for an experienced Senior Cloud AI/ML Engineer to lead the automation of complex financial workflows at Prosigliere. Description We are seeking a Senior Cloud AI/ML Engineer with a\ "cloud-first\" mindset to join our growing team. In this role, you won't just build models;
you will architect end-to-end intelligent systems that redefine how we handle financial data. You will be responsible for analyzing manual credit request processes and identifying opportunities to automate them using cutting-edge cloud AI services. The ideal candidate bridges the gap between raw data and actionable business intelligence, building tools that ingest high-stakes data from credit agencies, analyze it through sophisticated AI pipelines, and present it via human-in-the-loop dashboards. You will work closely with engineering leadership to turn manual bottlenecks into scalable, automated cloud solutions. Responsibilities Process Architecture: Analyze existing credit request workflows to identify automation opportunities using cloud-native AI/ML solutions. Intelligent Data Ingestion: Design and implement processes utilizing Document Intelligence (OCR/Form parsing), and Web Search integration to gather and structure fragmented data. Third-Party Data Synthesis: Build tools to ingest and analyze complex results from credit agencies (e.G., D&B, Experian, Equifax ) to drive automated decision-making. Custom Tooling: Develop custom software bridges to fill gaps between standard cloud AI services and specific business requirements. Human-in-the-Loop Systems: Create intuitive dashboards that visualize AI-driven analysis, allowing human reviewers to audit and approve automated recommendations. Cloud Deployment: Deploy and maintain robust MLOps pipelines in a cloud environment, ensuring high reliability and security for sensitive financial data. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Communicate technical AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate with backend teams to ensure seamless data flow. Technology Requirements 5+ years of experience in software engineering with a heavy focus on Cloud AI/ML implementations. Cloud-First Expertise: Proven experience with Vertex AI (GCP), Azure AI, or AWS SageMaker, specifically utilizing high-level AI services (Document AI, Search/Discovery, etc.). Data Integration: Proficiency in building API integrations and data pipelines that handle structured and unstructured data from external financial vendors. Python Mastery: Expert-level Python skills, including experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar frameworks for building agentic AI workflows. Visualization: Experience building data dashboards using tools like Streamlit, Looker, or custom React-based frontend components. Security Mindset: Deep understanding of handling sensitive PII (Personally Identifiable Information) within cloud environments. Profile Requirements Solution Architect Mentality: Ability to look at a manual business process and map it to a technical AI roadmap. Independent Problem Solver: A self-starter who can build\ "the bridge\" when a standardout-of-the-box tool doesn't exist. Strong Communication: Ability to explain why an AI made a specific recommendation to stakeholders. Agile Learner: A commitment to staying current with the rapid pace of LLM, RAG, and Agentic AI developments. AI Tooling: Proficiency with AI-first engineering approaches and tooling is a plus. If you are familiar with the Cognition platform with Windsurf and Devin, that is even better. Certifications: Google, Azure or AWS Cloud AI certifications are a big plus!

title: Engenheiro De Dados - Júnior
description:
Engenheiro de Dados - JúniorA jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui. Sobre a RethinkSomos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado. Diversidade e InclusãoPara repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência.Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente? Qual será o seu papel?Como Engenheiro de Dados Júnior, seu papel será crucial no apoio à construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes, principalmente no ambiente Databricks. Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados. Como será seu dia a dia?Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines;
Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados;
Ingerir, transformar e disponibilizar dados para consumo analítico;
Criar e manter tabelas Delta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises;
Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing;
Apoiar a governança de dados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões;
Monitorar execuções de pipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting;
Corrigir causas-raiz e propor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance;
Implementar e/ou apoiarvalidações de qualidade de dados;
Documentar pipelines, regras de negócio e a linhagem básica dos dados;
Colaborar com analistas, times de BI e áreas de negócio para entendimento de requisitos e evolução das entregas.Para esta vaga, é essencial:Conhecimento sólido de SQL (joins, agregações, CTEs, window functions e modelagem básica para analytics);
Conhecimento prático dePython para dados (manipulação, leitura/escrita e organização de código em notebooks);
Noções de Apache Spark/Databricks (DataFrames, particionamento, leitura/escrita em Delta e execução distribuída em alto nível);
Experiência inicial comDatabricks (uso de notebooks, jobs, clusters e boas práticas básicas);
Familiaridade com pipelines de dados e arquitetura Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold), mesmo em contexto acadêmico ou projetos;
Conhecimento emGit e controle de versão (branch, PR e resolução simples de conflitos);
Capacidade de investigar problemas (logs, métricas simples, reprocessamentos) e comunicar status com clareza;
Disponibilidadepara atuar com sustentação de rotinas, acompanhando falhas e correções dentro do horário acordado.Você pode se destacar se:Tiver experiência com Azure Data Factory (pipelines, triggers, integrações, parâmetros, monitoramento). Possuir conhecimento prático de Unity Catalog (permissões, data access, boas práticas de governança). Tiver vivência com Delta Sharing (publicação/consumo e cuidados com segurança e contratos de dados). Possuir experiência com orquestração e automação (Databricks Workflows, CI/CD, Databricks Repos, Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions). Tiver conhecimento em Data Quality e Observabilidade (ex.: Great Expectations/Deequ, métricas, SLIs/SLOs, alertas). Possuir experiência em otimização no Databricks/Delta (partitioning, Z-ORDER, OPTIMIZE/VACUUM, caching, controle de custos). Tiver noções de modelagem dimensional e consumo por ferramentas de BI (camadas semânticas, performance para dashboards). Possuir conhecimento de segurança e boas práticas (RBAC, segregação de ambientes, secrets, princípios de menor privilégio). Curtiu a oportunidade?Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Cloud Ai/Ml Engineer
description:
Looking for an experienced Senior Cloud AI/ML Engineer to lead the automation of complex financial workflows at Prosigliere. Description We are seeking a Senior Cloud AI/ML Engineer with a\ "cloud-first\" mindset to join our growing team. In this role, you won't just build models;
you will architect end-to-end intelligent systems that redefine how we handle financial data. You will be responsible for analyzing manual credit request processes and identifying opportunities to automate them using cutting-edge cloud AI services. The ideal candidate bridges the gap between raw data and actionable business intelligence, building tools that ingest high-stakes data from credit agencies, analyze it through sophisticated AI pipelines, and present it via human-in-the-loop dashboards. You will work closely with engineering leadership to turn manual bottlenecks into scalable, automated cloud solutions. Responsibilities Process Architecture: Analyze existing credit request workflows to identify automation opportunities using cloud-native AI/ML solutions. Intelligent Data Ingestion: Design and implement processes utilizing Document Intelligence (OCR/Form parsing), and Web Search integration to gather and structure fragmented data. Third-Party Data Synthesis: Build tools to ingest and analyze complex results from credit agencies (e.G., D&B, Experian, Equifax ) to drive automated decision-making. Custom Tooling: Develop custom software bridges to fill gaps between standard cloud AI services and specific business requirements. Human-in-the-Loop Systems: Create intuitive dashboards that visualize AI-driven analysis, allowing human reviewers to audit and approve automated recommendations. Cloud Deployment: Deploy and maintain robust MLOps pipelines in a cloud environment, ensuring high reliability and security for sensitive financial data. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Communicate technical AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate with backend teams to ensure seamless data flow. Technology Requirements 5+ years of experience in software engineering with a heavy focus on Cloud AI/ML implementations. Cloud-First Expertise: Proven experience with Vertex AI (GCP), Azure AI, or AWS SageMaker, specifically utilizing high-level AI services (Document AI, Search/Discovery, etc.). Data Integration: Proficiency in building API integrations and data pipelines that handle structured and unstructured data from external financial vendors. Python Mastery: Expert-level Python skills, including experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar frameworks for building agentic AI workflows. Visualization: Experience building data dashboards using tools like Streamlit, Looker, or custom React-based frontend components. Security Mindset: Deep understanding of handling sensitive PII (Personally Identifiable Information) within cloud environments. Profile Requirements Solution Architect Mentality: Ability to look at a manual business process and map it to a technical AI roadmap. Independent Problem Solver: A self-starter who can build\ "the bridge\" when a standardout-of-the-box tool doesn't exist. Strong Communication: Ability to explain why an AI made a specific recommendation to stakeholders. Agile Learner: A commitment to staying current with the rapid pace of LLM, RAG, and Agentic AI developments. AI Tooling: Proficiency with AI-first engineering approaches and tooling is a plus. If you are familiar with the Cognition platform with Windsurf and Devin, that is even better. Certifications: Google, Azure or AWS Cloud AI certifications are a big plus!

Arquivar pastas e prontuários de forma organizada;

title: Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCoNatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all. Role and responsibilitiesThe Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.Primary roles and responsibilities include:Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline managementMap priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs);
plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.Eligibility, due diligence & agreementsCoordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentationLead closure of contract signatures.Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).Reforestation delivery enablementTranslate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).Stakeholder engagement and safeguardsPlan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism.Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.ReportingLead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.Teamwork and cultureSupport the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects;
proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.Skills and attributesTo perform successfully in this role, you will have:A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skillsExcellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partnersAbility to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.LocationRemote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or BahiaSubmission instructionsEmail CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery ManagerSubmission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Cientista De Dados
description: Quem somos? Com 8 anos de história, a TerraMagna vive a missão de tornar a agricultura tudo aquilo que o mundo precisa que ela seja. Hoje atua como financiadora da cadeia de insumos do agronegócio, visando ser seu sistema operacional e principal parceiro financeiro. Possui mais de 1 bilhão de reais sob gestão, captou 75 milhões em rodada de investimentos e atua com clientes em todo o Brasil. O Desafio e o Time de Modelagem Como uma startup em constante desenvolvimento, nosso ambiente é dinâmico e exige autonomia. O Time de Modelagem é enxuto e focado em resolver problemas complexos de risco de crédito e de análise de dados no agronegócio. Buscamos um Cientista de Dados experiente, com perfil voltado para mentoria e trabalho em equipe. Acreditamos em um ambiente de trabalho livre e flexível, por isso, a confiança é a base de tudo que fazemos. Valorizamos pessoas movidas a novos desafios, capazes de desbravar o agronegócio e nos ajudar na nossa principal missão, que é levar para o agronegócio o insumo mais importante: o crédito. Dia a dia Desenvolver, implementar e monitorar modelos estatísticos e de machine learning, especialmente modelos de credit scoring e análise de risco. Produtizar os modelos, trabalhando de forma autônoma desde a concepção até a implementação em ambiente de produção. Colaborar com a liderança técnica na definição da arquitetura de dados e nas escolhas tecnológicas do time. Traduzir problemas complexos de negócio em soluções baseadas em dados, comunicando os resultados de forma clara para audiências técnicas e não técnicas. Colaborar dinamicamente com os times de produto e engenharia. Manter-se atualizado com tendências e melhores práticas em Engenharia e Ciência de Dados. Requisitos 3+ anos de experiência atuando como Cientista de Dados, preferencialmente em ambientes de startup ou empresas de tecnologia. Domínio em probabilidade e estatística e em modelos de machine learning supervisionados e não supervisionados. Domínio em Python e principais bibliotecas para Ciência de Dados (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, etc.). Forte conhecimento em SQL (modelagem, performance e manipulação de grandes volumes de dados). Experiência no desenvolvimento e operacionalização de pipelines de machine learning ponta a ponta em produção (exploração e preparação de dados, limpeza, engenharia de atributos, modelagem e avaliação), com foco em escalabilidade, reprodutibilidade, segurança e monitoramento contínuo de performance dos modelos. Experiência com práticas de engenharia para produção de modelos, incluindo versionamento de código com Git/Github, deploy em nuvem, automação de fluxos e suporte ao monitoramento e manutenção dos modelos em produção. Familiaridade com serviços em nuvem, preferencialmente Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Perfil proativo, com capacidade para atuar em problemas ambíguos, autonomia para estruturar o caminho analítico e excelente habilidade de comunicação para alinhamento com múltiplos stakeholders. Interesse genuíno em evoluir tecnicamente em um ambiente dinâmico de fintech. Diferenciais Formação acadêmica em Estatística, Ciência da Computação, Ciência de Dados, Engenharias, Matemática, Física, Economia ou áreas correlatas. Experiência prévia com modelagem de risco de crédito, credit scoring ou detecção de fraudes. Conhecimento de metodologias de inferência causal e experimentação. Experiência em projetos envolvendo metaheurísticas aplicadas a problemas de otimização combinatória. Conhecimento ou experiência prévia no setor do Agronegócio (AgTechs). Experiência no setor de serviços financeiros ou em projetos relacionados a crédito e risco. Conhecimento em manuseio de dags (Airflow ou similar) para composição de bases de dados para análises exploratórias e treinamento de modelos. O que temos por aqui: Trabalho remoto, com encontros ocasionais na sede em São José dos Campos - SP. Remuneração compatível (PJ). Benefício flexível via cartão Swile. Wellhub (antigo Gympass). Convênio médico Porto Saúde. Convênio odontológico Uniodonto.

title: Account Manager - Soluções De Cibersegurança
description: 1) Sobre a SolutionMall A SolutionMall é uma plataforma global B2B focada no fornecimento de soluções integradas e produtos profissionais para projetos de infraestrutura e indústria. Não atuamos apenas como uma plataforma tradicional de fornecimento de produtos. Damos grande importância à segurança, praticidade e adequação de sistemas e equipamentos utilizados em projetos reais, sempre considerando as necessidades de operação de longo prazo. Na visão da SolutionMall, a cibersegurança não se limita a uma única categoria de software. Ela é um requisito essencial em sistemas, dispositivos conectados e na lógica geral de implantação de projetos. Mesmo em equipamentos básicos, valorizamos protocolos de comunicação segura, gestão de senhas, controle de acesso e proteção de privacidade. Acreditamos que a segurança deve ser incorporada desde o início no desenho do sistema, na seleção de produtos e na lógica de implementação. title: Cientista De Dados
description:
A missão do Cientista de Dados será atuar no desenvolvimento de soluções analíticas para um produto de Analytics voltado a softwares de RH, contribuindo com a análise e modelagem de dados voltados à gestão de pessoas e processos. Fará parte de um time multidisciplinar responsável por criar modelos preditivos, gerar insights estratégicos e estruturar pipelines de dados eficientes. Também participará da implementação e treinamento de LLMs (Large Language Models) aplicados ao contexto de RH, apoiando a evolução do produto com foco em personalização e escalabilidade. O profissional terá um papel essencial na transformação de dados complexos em soluções inteligentes e aplicáveis ao negócio. O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER: Trabalhar em equipe no desenvolvimento de soluções analíticas aplicadas ao contexto de Recursos Humanos. Realizar exploração, tratamento e modelagem de dados para gerar insights estratégicos. Desenvolver modelos estatísticos e preditivos voltados à análise de comportamento, desempenho e gestão de pessoas. Atuar na implementação, ajuste fino e avaliação de desempenho de LLMs aplicados ao produto. Traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções baseadas em dados. Contribuir com a documentação técnica e boas práticas de ciência de dados. Colaborar com times de produto, engenharia e UX para garantir integração fluida das soluções ao produto final. Participar de testes, validações e iterações de modelos em ambiente de produção. Acompanhar tendências e inovações na área de dados e inteligência artificial, especialmente em aplicações de RH. O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ: Graduação completa em Ciência de Dados, Estatística, Engenharia, Matemática, Computação ou áreas correlatas. Experiência prática com modelagem estatística, machine learning e análise exploratória de dados. Domínio de linguagens como Python (pandas, scikit-learn, NumPy, etc.) e SQL. Conhecimento em conceitos e aplicações de LLMs (Large Language Models). Capacidade de traduzir problemas de negócio em soluções analíticas. Boa comunicação e habilidade para trabalhar em equipe multidisciplinar. SERIA LEGAL SE TIVESSE: Experiência prévia com dados de RH ou People Analytics. Conhecimento de ferramentas de visualização (ex: Metabase, Power BI, Tableau, Dash, etc.). Experiência com deployment de modelos em ambiente de produção. Pós-graduação ou cursos especializados em Ciência de Dados ou IA. title: Salesforce Consultant
description: Job Title: Salesforce CRM Systems Analyst Introduction: We are seeking a highly skilled Salesforce CRM Systems Analyst with 7 to 10 years of experience to join our dynamic team. This role is pivotal in optimizing and managing our Salesforce ecosystem, driving business growth through effective CRM solutions. The ideal candidate will leverage their expertise in Sales Cloud, application administration, integration, and AI-led automation to enhance user experience, streamline processes, and deliver actionable insights. This position plays a critical role in aligning Salesforce capabilities with organizational goals, ensuring seamless collaboration across departments and maximizing CRM value. Roles and Responsibilities: Lead the administration and configuration of the Salesforce Sales Cloud platform to support business processes and user requirements. Design, develop, and implement integrations between Salesforce and third-party systems to ensure data consistency and process automation. Collaborate with stakeholders to gather and analyze business requirements and translate them into scalable Salesforce solutions. Manage and optimize Salesforce application administration tasks including user management, security roles, profiles, workflows, and validation rules. Drive AI-led automation initiatives within Salesforce to enhance sales productivity and decision-making using tools such as Einstein Analytics and AI-driven workflows. Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and implement enhancements to maintain optimal CRM functionality. Develop training materials and conduct user training sessions to promote adoption and effective use of Salesforce features. Stay current with Salesforce releases, features, and best practices to continuously improve system capabilities. Collaborate closely with IT, sales, marketing, and customer service teams to ensure Salesforce supports cross-functional business needs. Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field. 7 to 10 years of hands-on experience as a Salesforce Systems Analyst or Administrator with a focus on Sales Cloud. Salesforce certifications such as Salesforce Certified Administrator, Salesforce Certified Sales Cloud Consultant, or equivalent are highly preferred. Demonstrated experience in application administration, configuration, and customization of Salesforce environments. Proven expertise in integrating Salesforce with external applications using APIs, middleware, or integration platforms. Strong knowledge of AI-led automation tools within Salesforce, including Einstein Analytics and process automation capabilities. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to work collaboratively across teams. Experience with Agile methodologies and project management is a plus. Tools and Technologies: Salesforce Sales Cloud Salesforce Application Administration (User Management, Security, Workflows, Validation Rules) Salesforce Integration Tools (APIs, REST/SOAP, Middleware like MuleSoft, Dell Boomi) AI-led Automation Tools (Salesforce Einstein, Einstein Analytics, AI-driven Process Automation) Data Management and Reporting tools within Salesforce Familiarity with Agile project management software (e.G., Jira, Confluence)

title: Salesforce Consultant
description: Job Title: Salesforce CRM Systems Analyst Introduction: We are seeking a highly skilled Salesforce CRM Systems Analyst with 7 to 10 years of experience to join our dynamic team. This role is pivotal in optimizing and managing our Salesforce ecosystem, driving business growth through effective CRM solutions. The ideal candidate will leverage their expertise in Sales Cloud, application administration, integration, and AI-led automation to enhance user experience, streamline processes, and deliver actionable insights. This position plays a critical role in aligning Salesforce capabilities with organizational goals, ensuring seamless collaboration across departments and maximizing CRM value. Roles and Responsibilities: Lead the administration and configuration of the Salesforce Sales Cloud platform to support business processes and user requirements. Design, develop, and implement integrations between Salesforce and third-party systems to ensure data consistency and process automation. Collaborate with stakeholders to gather and analyze business requirements and translate them into scalable Salesforce solutions. Manage and optimize Salesforce application administration tasks including user management, security roles, profiles, workflows, and validation rules. Drive AI-led automation initiatives within Salesforce to enhance sales productivity and decision-making using tools such as Einstein Analytics and AI-driven workflows. Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and implement enhancements to maintain optimal CRM functionality. Develop training materials and conduct user training sessions to promote adoption and effective use of Salesforce features. Stay current with Salesforce releases, features, and best practices to continuously improve system capabilities. Collaborate closely with IT, sales, marketing, and customer service teams to ensure Salesforce supports cross-functional business needs. Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field. 7 to 10 years of hands-on experience as a Salesforce Systems Analyst or Administrator with a focus on Sales Cloud. Salesforce certifications such as Salesforce Certified Administrator, Salesforce Certified Sales Cloud Consultant, or equivalent are highly preferred. Demonstrated experience in application administration, configuration, and customization of Salesforce environments. Proven expertise in integrating Salesforce with external applications using APIs, middleware, or integration platforms. Strong knowledge of AI-led automation tools within Salesforce, including Einstein Analytics and process automation capabilities. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to work collaboratively across teams. Experience with Agile methodologies and project management is a plus. Tools and Technologies: Salesforce Sales Cloud Salesforce Application Administration (User Management, Security, Workflows, Validation Rules) Salesforce Integration Tools (APIs, REST/SOAP, Middleware like MuleSoft, Dell Boomi) AI-led Automation Tools (Salesforce Einstein, Einstein Analytics, AI-driven Process Automation) Data Management and Reporting tools within Salesforce Familiarity with Agile project management software (e.G., Jira, Confluence)

title: Emerging Market Trader
description: Role Overview We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties. Key Responsibilities FX Trading & Liquidity Management Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on African (e.G., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.G., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets. Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions. Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure. Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets. Hedging Strategy & Risk Management Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures. Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant. Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization. Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books. Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including: Automated hedging engines Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols. Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring. Market Development Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows. Requirements Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets. Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies, such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades. Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets NDF markets and offshore hedging Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems Hedging engines Liquidity aggregation platforms Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution. Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments. Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks. Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations. Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources. Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies. Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations. Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Staff Data Scientist
description: Cientista de Dados Sobre a Arvo Temos o propósito de tornar a saúde no Brasil mais acessível para todos. Nossa jornada começa com o uso de dados e inteligência artificial para reduzir fraudes, abusos e desperdícios em pagamentos de saúde. Acreditamos que a única maneira de alcançar isso é através de um time incrível, com pessoas apaixonadas por saúde e compradas na nossa missão de transformar o setor. Perfil desejado Buscamos uma pessoa cientista de dados com forte capacidade analítica, curiosidade e autonomia para explorar novos problemas e domínios. Alguém com perfil crítico e generalista, que se motive mais por entender e resolver problemas complexos com dados do que apenas por desenvolver modelos ou escrever código. Procuramos alguém que combine rigor técnico e pensamento científico, com uma barra de qualidade alta. Que seja capaz de propor hipóteses, testar soluções de forma estruturada e entregar resultados robustos, bem validados e sustentáveis. Responsabilidades Analisar dados complexos e extrair insights que gerem valor para o negócio e para os clientes Desenvolver relatórios, dashboards e visualizações de dados para comunicação de resultados Identificar tendências, padrões e anomalias nos dados para apoiar a tomada de decisão estratégica Trabalhar em conjunto com as equipes de engenharia de dados para garantir qualidade, integridade e acessibilidade dos dados Criar e documentar métricas de desempenho e indicadores-chave para monitoramento dos processos Apoiar na definição de requisitos e especificação de soluções baseadas em dados Realizar estudos de viabilidade e análise de impacto de soluções propostas Comunicar de forma clara e objetiva os achados analíticos para diferentes stakeholders Qualificações Mínimas Formação em Engenharia, Matemática, Estatística ou área correlata Conhecimento em Python Experiência com análise de dados e geração de insights acionáveis Experiência em manipulação e consulta de bancos de dados SQL e não relacionais Boa comunicação para interagir com diferentes stakeholders e traduzir requisitos de negócio em soluções analíticas Experiência com modelagem estatística ou machine learning. Qualificações Desejadas Experiência na área de healthtech Conhecimento em ferramentas de ETL Familiaridade com Google Cloud (GCP) e BigQuery Descrição da vaga Essa pessoa será responsável por analisar dados complexos da carteira de clientes, identificar padrões e oportunidades e traduzir insights em recomendações estratégicas. Trabalhará em parceria com os times de Business e Health, desenvolvendo relatórios e dashboards que apoiem a tomada de decisão. Também atuará junto à engenharia de dados para garantir a qualidade e acessibilidade das informações, além de definir métricas e indicadores para monitorar o desempenho das iniciativas. title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L Job Overview: We are looking for experienced engineers with deep design expertise to create challenging, simulation-based design problems for training and evaluating advanced AI models. The role focuses on crafting realistic engineering design tasks where a model must make genuine trade-offs, size components, and iterate against physics-based simulators to meet competing specifications. Key Responsibilities: Design and validate simulation-based engineering problems that require true design reasoning, with clear constraints and optimization goals. Deliver complete problem sets including reference solutions, near-miss variants, edge cases, and documentation, ensure appropriate difficulty with multiple failure modes, and collaborate with researchers to refine problems based on model performance. Domain Tracks: You should have deep design expertise in at least one of the followin g;
expertise spanning multiple tracks is a strong plus. Electrical & Computer Engineering — analog/mixed-signal IC design, power electronics, RF/microwave, digital system design, FPGA/ASIC, embedded systems. Mechanical Engineering — structural/thermal/fluid system design, mechanism design, HVAC, vibration/dynamics, manufacturing process design. Chemical Engineering — reactor design, process design and optimization, separation systems, transport phenomena, combustion and thermochemistry. Control Systems — classical and modern control design, state estimation, nonlinear and robust control, system identification. Materials / Nano — materials selection under constraints, microstructure-property design, thin-film and nanoscale device design. Engineering Physics / Optics — optical system design, photonic device design, laser systems, wave propagation and interference. Aerospace Engineering — aerodynamic design, propulsion sizing, orbital mechanics, flight dynamics and stability, structural design for aerospace loads. Civil / Structural Engineering — structural member and connection design, foundation design, seismic/wind loading, geotechnical design. Nuclear / Energy — reactor core design, shielding, thermal-hydraulics, renewable energy system sizing, grid-scale storage design. Systems Engineering — system architecture trade studies, requirements decomposition, interface design, multi-subsystem integration. Robotics — kinematic/dynamic design, motion planning, actuator and sensor selection, mechatronic system integration. Required Qualifications: Master’s or PhD in a relevant engineering/applied science field. 3+ years of hands-on engineering design experience, producing validated designs from competing specs (not just analysis). Proficient in at least one open-source simulation tool relevant to the domain. Strong Python (or equivalent) scripting skills. High attention to detail across units, boundary conditions, convergence, and physical realism. Offer Details: Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. Engagement type: Contractor Evaluation Process: Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form. After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements. After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile. Know amazing talent? Refer /referrals, and earn money from your network.

Configurar, evoluir e automatizar pipelines CI/CD no GitLab com integração de ferramentas de segurança (SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets scanning), garantindo que segurança faça parte do fluxo de entrega. Apoiar times de desenvolvimento na adoção de práticas de desenvolvimento seguro (Secure SDLC), conduzindo análises de código e orientações sobre boas práticas de segurança. Criar automações para monitoramento, detecção de ameaças, resposta a incidentes e hardening de ambientes, reduzindo a superfície de ataque de forma contínua. Atuar na segurança de infraestruturas multicloud (AWS, Azure e/ou GCP), incluindo IAM, gestão de segredos, redes e conformidade com políticas de segurança. Colaborar com squads e stakeholders técnicos para disseminar cultura de segurança, participar de revisões de arquitetura e contribuir proativamente com soluções inovadoras. Manter-se atualizado(a) sobre o cenário de ameaças, CVEs relevantes e novas tecnologias de segurança, trazendo insights para o time. Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter: Experiência com threat modeling, revisão de arquitetura de apps e sites, e conhecimento de OWASP Top 10 e boas práticas de segurança em APIs REST/GraphQL. Domínio avançado de GitLab CI/CD, com experiência em configurar stages de segurança (SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets detection) e integrar ferramentas como Trivy, Semgrep ou similares. Conhecimento de práticas como code review com foco em segurança, análise de dependências vulneráveis, gestão de segredos e políticas de controle de acesso. Capacidade de desenvolver scripts, playbooks e automações (Python, Bash ou similares) para triagem de alertas, resposta a incidentes e hardening de ambientes. Experiência em ao menos um provedor (AWS, Azure ou GCP) com foco em IAM, segurança de redes, gestão de segredos (Vault, KMS) e conformidade (CIS Benchmarks, CSPM). Familiaridade com OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite, Snyk, SonarQube, Checkov, Prowler ou equivalentes. Você irá se destacar se: Conhecimento de frameworks como NIST, ISO 27001 ou SOC 2. title: Digital Business Analyst
description: Digital Business Analyst – Shape the Future of Energy Reporting & Operations! We are recruiting on behalf of a global energy services organisation operating across Gas & Power Services. This programme sits at the heart of operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and customer transparency - replacing fragmented, manual reporting with a scalable digital reporting solution across complex industrial assets. You’ll join a long-term, high-impact transformation programme focused on power plant operations, Operations & Maintenance (O&M), and performance reporting. This is a discovery-heavy role with real ownership, working directly with senior stakeholders to define what the product should be, before it’s built. As a Digital Business Analyst, you’ll lead domain discovery, define product capabilities, and act as the bridge between business stakeholders and delivery teams to turn complex operational needs into a clear, scalable digital solution. Your Role: You’ll be the bridge between operations, data, and delivery. This is a senior, hands-on role where you’ll rapidly onboard into the Gas & Power Services domain, lead structured discovery, and shape a digital reporting product from the ground up - with ownership through to delivery and value realisation. What You’ll Do: Lead structured interviews and workshops with domain heads and SMEs to capture current-state (“as-is”) processes, data flows, and pain points Translate business needs into clear product capabilities, outcomes, and success measures Define reporting requirements, data inputs, ownership models, and KPIs across performance, efficiency, safety, environmental, and financial metrics Balance standardisation and configurability across plants, equipment types, and markets Create and maintain product vision, roadmap, capability maps, and a prioritised backlog Define the end-to-end data and reporting strategy - from data collection and validation through to dashboards and customer-facing outputs Work closely with Solution Architects to ensure technical feasibility, scalability, and long-term sustainability Act as the primary bridge between business stakeholders and delivery teams, driving clarity and momentum Lead demos, clarify scope boundaries, and align expectations on custom vs configurable functionality Support planning, estimation, sequencing, and governance across a multi-phase programme Track progress against milestones and help define what success looks like by September 2026 What You Bring: Proven ability to lead discovery independently and bring structure to ambiguous environments Experience working on data-driven products, reporting systems, or analytics platforms Experience with international, enterprise environments Excellent stakeholder management and facilitation skills across senior, operational, and technical audiences Confidence translating complex operational domains into clear, actionable requirements Exposure to energy, utilities, power generation, or industrial operations is highly desirable Familiarity with operational KPIs, asset performance management, and HSE reporting is a strong plus Experience working with dashboards, BI tools, or custom reporting solutions Why Join the Remobi community: Fully remote B2B / freelance contracts Access to high-impact roles across AI, FinTech, and modern infrastructure A strong community of senior engineers, curated content, and role alerts Work with fast-scaling companies where your impact is visible and valued Apply today: If you’re a Digital Business Analyst who thrives in discovery, enjoys shaping products from complex operational environments, and wants to deliver measurable business value in the energy sector - we’d love to hear from you.

title: Ai Agent Manager (Media)
description: About the Product For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections. The Manager owns the agent-building roadmap, advanced prompt engineering, agent configuration and deployment, performance monitoring, and cross-functional coordination to drive successful AI adoption across the organization. Duties and Responsibilities Main Responsibilities Design, build, and maintain AI-powered workflows and agents using low-code/no-code and prompt-based platforms (e.G., multi-step prompt systems, agent frameworks). Translate business requirements into scalable AI-driven solutions, especially for internal process automation (e.G., media planning, operations, finance workflows). Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to understand use cases and define solution logic. Act as a bridge between business teams and technical infrastructure, ensuring solutions are usable by non-technical users. Test, iterate, and improve AI agents to ensure reliability, accuracy, and performance in real-world use cases. Identify opportunities for automation across departments and proactively propose AI-driven improvements. Document workflows, prompt logic, and system configurations for internal reuse and scalability. Stay up to date with advancements in AI tools, LLM capabilities, and no-code/low-code ecosystems. Core Requirements 4–7+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, System Analyst, or similar role. Strong ability to translate business processes into structured workflows and logic. Hands-on experience with low-code/no-code tools (e.G., Zapier, Make, Airtable, Retool, or similar platforms). Experience working with AI tools (LLMs, prompt engineering, or AI automation platforms). Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently and own end-to-end solution delivery. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher) Technical / AI-Related Experience designing multi-step prompts or AI workflows (not just single prompts). Understanding of how LLMs work and how to structure prompts for reliable outputs. Familiarity with APIs, integrations, and automation tools is a plus. Basic programming knowledge is helpful but not required. Soft Skills Strong communication skills and ability to work with non-technical stakeholders. Business-oriented mindset with a focus on practical outcomes. Curiosity and willingness to experiment with new AI tools and approaches. Ability to operate in an ambiguous, fast-evolving environment. Domain Experience Experience in digital media, advertising tech, or media planning. Knowledge, Skills & Abilities Proven ability to design, build, and operate sophisticated AI agents. Expertise in advanced prompt engineering, including multi-step prompting, few-shot learning, and optimizing for specific model outputs. Strong business analysis fundamentals: elicitation, documentation, process mapping, traceability, UAT. Ability to produce and manage, work autonomously, and take initiative. Exceptional relationship-building skills, cultural competency, and ability to communicate effectively with diverse groups of people and roles. Dexterity to effectively deal with ambiguity, change, and continuous process improvements. We offer We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team. Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule). Personal laptop. Health and wellness package. Fully remote. As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

title: Analista De Customer Experience
description:
About Client Our client is a leading AI-powered Analytics Platform as a Service (AnPaaS) that empowers product teams and developers to embed conversational, predictive, and agentic intelligence directly into applications and workflows. Our API-first, developer-first platform turns complex data into faster, smarter, actionable decisions for global customers across financial services, retail, healthcare, and technology. With the recent launch of client Intelligence and Intelligence Assistant, we're accelerating innovation in embedded analytics, enabling governed, scalable AI experiences that bridge insights to real-time action. The Role As a Strategic Customer Success Manager, you will serve as a trusted advisor to mid-sized to large enterprise accounts, building deep relationships to maximize value, drive adoption of our AI-powered platform, and fuel retention and expansion. You'll collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support to ensure customers achieve their business goals through clear communication of complex concepts and proactive guidance. Why Join Our Customer Success Team This is a strategic, high-impact role where you'll own complex accounts, strengthen multi-threaded relationships, and deliver measurable outcomes (e.G., NRR, expansion revenue, AI feature adoption). You'll work in a collaborative, innovative global environment, partnering with diverse teams to solve real customer challenges and contribute to product growth in embedded AI analytics. About You You thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments, adapting quickly while staying positive and solution-focused. You're a natural relationship builder, skilled at nurturing trusted, multi-level partnerships and positioning yourself as a key advisor to drive customer success. You quickly grasp business goals and technical concepts (including AI/analytics platforms) to align solutions with customer needs. You're proactive and consultative, identifying opportunities, anticipating challenges, and advocating for customers while balancing business priorities. You're collaborative, open to feedback, and passionate about delivering results through continuous learning and improvement. Requirements 3–5+ years as a Customer Success Manager (or equivalent), with proven success managing enterprise/mid-market accounts (SaaS/BI/analytics preferred). Strong track record of driving product adoption, value realization, and revenue expansion. Excellent presentation and executive communication skills;
experience leading EBRs/QBRs and building C-level relationships. Ability to own full account planning, health monitoring, and success strategy across a portfolio. Proactive mindset: identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities, mitigate risks, and deliver measurable ROI. Project management skills to handle complex implementations, onboarding, and technical discussions. Experience collaborating cross-functionally (Sales, Product, Engineering) to resolve issues and influence roadmaps. Exceptional interpersonal, listening, written, and verbal skills (fluent English required;
Portuguese a plus). Results-driven with strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and a customer-centric focus. Comfortable in a dynamic, remote environment while managing multiple priorities. Bonus: Background in Business Intelligence (BI), embedded analytics, AI/GenAI enablement, or similar technical solutions. How You'll Ramp By Day 30 Complete Customer Success onboarding and training (client values, culture, relationship techniques, product overview, competition, and transformational outcomes). Begin meeting customers, shadowing QBRs/EBRs, and observing how we build relationships and deliver value. By Day 60 Develop strategic account plans for your portfolio and start driving opportunities (adoption, expansion, renewals). Deepen product and technical knowledge through coaching and hands-on work. Fully embed with your accounts and collaborate side by side with the team. By Day 90 Own your book of business end-to-end, driving partnership success and measurable results (NRR, adoption, expansion). Master Customer Success best practices, including onboarding, proactive risk management, and AI feature enablement. Become a key contributor to the team's revenue retention and growth goals. Join Client! Our client is pioneering the future of embedded analytics with AI at the core. This role offers more than a position — it’s an opportunity to shape customer outcomes in a transformative industry, work with a diverse, innovative global team, and grow in a collaborative culture that values impact and inclusivity. If you're passionate about driving strategic customer success in AI-powered analytics, apply today. Let’s build the next era of intelligent decisions together.

title: Assistente De Auditoria E Performance
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.Responsabilidades e atribuiçõesApoiar o acompanhamento do painel de vendas, contribuindo para a organização e atualização das informações comerciais do shopping;

Dar suporte ao fechamento mensal das operações, ajudando na consolidação e conferência dos dados;

title: Analista De Supply Chain (Comex & Procurement)
description:

Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work. Overview of the role: We are looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to join our team and help drive our growth. As a Supply Chain Analyst, you will play a critical and active role in the day-to-day operations. This is an excellent opportunity to be one of the key members of our team and position yourself for unique career growth opportunities. - Prepare cost-benefit analysis reports for review by managers. Requirements: - 2+ years of experience in a supply management role or related position.
- Knowledge of SAP or SAP B1.

- Experience in managing inventory.
- Proficiency in SQL analysis tools and mathematical analysis.
- Interpersonal skills and ability to build and improve trust.
- Advanced level of English. Benefits: - Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.
- Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.
- Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.
- Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.
- Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.
- Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.
- Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.
- Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement. If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

description:

title: Analista Financeiro Ii (Financial Analyst)
description:
Company DescriptionUpstream Capital is a tactical investor focused on growth-stage technology companies, deploying both debt and equity to scale businesses. Headquartered in São Paulo, Brazil, the firm has a global reach, with a proven track record of investing over $200 million in over 25 tech companies across Latin America, the Bay Area, and other regions. With deep expertise in the tech sector, Upstream Capital operates as a comprehensive finance platform leveraging knowledge, networking, data, and AI to drive success. The company is committed to partnering with innovative businesses, finding creative solutions to complex challenges, and aligning success between investors and investees for long-term growth.Role DescriptionThe role is designed for someone who is deeply curious about how companies operate, how their economics work, and what are the patterns that makes some of them thrive. The Intern will be exposed to the full investment process and encouraged to think critically about markets and capital allocation.Beyond analytical work, we value people who enjoy engaging with the broader investment landscape. The role involves listening, asking good questions, forming independent views, and contributing ideas to internal discussions. Curiosity and judgment matter as much as technical skills.Upstream operates in a lean, high-ownership environment. Interns are expected to take responsibility for their work, explore opportunities proactively, and learn by doing. We look for individuals who are comfortable navigating ambiguity and who see feedback and mistakes as part of the learning process.Candidates may come from any academic background. What matters is intellectual rigor, attention to detail, and a consistent pattern of high personal standards. Prior exposure to finance, consulting, or technology is a plus, but not a prerequisite.Qualifications- Proficiency in Financial Modeling and deep understanding of Finance principles- Ability to communicate insights effectively through reports and presentations- Experience in, or knowledge of, the technology sector is a plus- Fluency in English;
proficiency in Portuguese and/or Spanish is strongly preferred- Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related fieldAbout UsFormerly known as Upload Ventures Growth, Upstream has the goal of becoming a platform for lifecycle investing in growth and late-stage technology companies. The firm builds on Upload’s track record of supporting global founders and leverages its experience in venture capital, technology, and data to identify, underwrite, and scale high-performing businesses.Upstream operates with a lean structure and a hands-on approach. We value analytical rigor, operational discipline, and the ability to execute with precision in fast-paced environments.

title: Analista De Customer Experience
description: Company: ScalixAI Location: Fully Remote Type: Full-time Reports to: Founder / CEO About ScalixAI ScalixAI is a performance-focused Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads agency built on one principle: paid media should drive real business outcomes, not vanity metrics. Founded by a former 8-year Google veteran, we work with ambitious SaaS companies, B2B brands, nonprofits, home services operators, and growth-stage businesses who expect more than dashboards — they expect partnership, strategy, and results. We're small, sharp, and scaling. This role is central to how we grow. The Role We're hiring a Senior Customer Success Manager who lives at the intersection of Google Ads expertise, LinkedIn Ads fluency, and high-trust client relationships. You'll own a book of business end-to-end — from kickoff through renewal — and be the strategic voice clients rely on when they want to know why the numbers are moving and what to do next. This isn't a reporting role. This is a thinking-partner role. You'll build campaigns that actually ladder up to revenue, translate performance into narrative, and hold the line on strategy when clients push in unproductive directions. What You'll Own Client relationships. You are the face of ScalixAI for your accounts. You lead weekly/bi-weekly calls, quarterly business reviews, and the hard conversations that come with managing paid media budgets. Campaign strategy and execution. You build, optimize, and scale Google Ads (Search, PMax, Demand Gen, Display, YouTube) and LinkedIn Ads (Sponsored Content, Message Ads, Lead Gen Forms, ABM campaigns) across multiple verticals. Storytelling through data. You turn performance data into a narrative the client's CEO, CMO, or founder actually wants to read. Numbers alone don't retain clients — meaning does. Attribution and measurement. You set up clean measurement (GA4, LinkedIn Insight Tag, conversion APIs, offline conversion imports) and defend the integrity of attribution when the data gets messy. Proactive optimization. You don't wait for the client to ask. You spot, flag, and fix. Retention and expansion. You identify opportunities to expand scope and you catch churn signals before they become churn. What We're Looking For Required: 5–8 years of hands-on paid media experience, with meaningful time spent in both Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads (not just one with a side of the other) Direct, in-platform experience with Fibbler Proven track record managing client relationships as the primary point of contact — ideally in an agency or consultancy setting Strong storytelling ability: you can write a QBR narrative, present on Zoom with confidence, and explain a CPA spike in a way that builds trust rather than erodes it Deep technical fluency in campaign architecture, bidding strategies, audience segmentation, creative testing, and conversion tracking across both platforms Comfort with attribution conversations — last-click vs. data-driven, view-through, offline conversion imports, CRM-integrated measurement B2B and SaaS paid media experience Bonus: HVAC, home services, or nonprofit vertical experience Familiarity with tools like HubSpot, Salesforce, GA4, Looker Studio, Supermetrics, HockeyStack, or similar LinkedIn Marketing Labs certification and/or Google Ads certifications Experience building SOPs, onboarding docs, or client-facing collateral Who Thrives Here You treat client accounts like you own them, because at ScalixAI, you effectively do. You have opinions and you can defend them — but you also know when to flex. You're allergic to fluff. You'd rather say "here's what's working, here's what isn't, here's what we're changing" than hide behind a 40-slide deck. You want to work on a team that moves fast, ships work, and treats paid media as a craft — not a commodity. What We Offer Fully remote — work from anywhere that overlaps reasonably with North American client hours Direct access to the founder and real input on how the agency is built A portfolio of clients who actually want to be partnered with (we screen hard at the front door) Room to grow into team leadership as we scale How to Apply Send us: A short note on the most interesting paid media problem you've solved in the last 12 months — across either Google or LinkedIn Your resume or LinkedIn profile One QBR, case study, or client-facing deliverable you're proud of (redact as needed) We read everything. We respond to everyone who takes the time to apply thoughtfully.

title: Especialista De Soluções E Pré-Vendas
description:

Na mesma época, houve uma expansão comercial significativa, que foi acompanhada por um aumento de casos de fraudes. Foi nesse momento que a assumimos a responsabilidade de garantir a segurança das empresas e entramos em ação. Ao longo desses 30 anos, a GIF tem trabalhado incansavelmente na prevenção, detecção e combate às fraudes corporativas. Company DescriptionUpstream Capital is a tactical investor focused on growth-stage technology companies, deploying both debt and equity to scale businesses. Prior exposure to finance, consulting, or technology is a plus, but not a prerequisite.QualificationsProficiency in Financial Modeling and deep understanding of Finance principlesAbility to communicate insights effectively through reports and presentationsExperience in, or knowledge of, the technology sector is a plusFluency in English;
proficiency in Portuguese and/or Spanish is strongly preferredBachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related fieldAbout UsFormerly known as Upload Ventures Growth, Upstream has the goal of becoming a platform for lifecycle investing in growth and late-stage technology companies. We value analytical rigor, operational discipline, and the ability to execute with precision in fast-paced environments.

title: Digital Analytics
description:
About Turing:Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge;
and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.Role Overview:We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!What does day-to-day look like:You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:- Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)- In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.G. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.Requirements:- Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)- Analytical Skills: Good research and analytical skills- Feedback Skills: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.- Creative Thinking: Creative and lateral thinking abilities.- Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.- Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.- Commitment: Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.- Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.Preferred Qualifications:- Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.- Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)- Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.- Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.Perks of Freelancing With Turing:- Work in a fully remote environment.- Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.- Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.Offer Details:- Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)- Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred.
