title: Cloud Systems Engineer/Devops
description:
About the ProductFor more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.Role OverviewWe are seeking an expert-level, highly skilled Cloud Systems Engineer (DevOps) to serve as a GCP Specialist and technical builder for our Google Cloud ecosystem. This role requires more than administration;
you must be capable ofbuilding architectural change, adjusting systems, and driving modernization efforts. You will be responsible for the end-to-end management of our GCP infrastructure, from complex networking to proactive cost optimization and resource scaling. A key responsibility is leading and running large-scale cloud migration projects, specifically from AWS to GCP.The ideal candidate ensures our Compute Engine environment is lean, fast, and resilient while maintaining secure connectivity using both native and third-party VPN solutions.The role's primary focus demands deep GCP expertise, but candidates must also possess significant experience with AWS for successful migrationstrategy.Key Responsibilities- Infrastructure & Networking: Configure and maintain robust networking architectures, including Cloud DNS and Cloud NAT.- Linux System Administration: Manage and maintain the operating system environment on Compute Engine instances, including patching, configuration management, user account management, and troubleshooting core system issues.- VPN Management: Build and manage secure tunnels using Cloud VPN, pfSense virtual appliances, and CloudConnexa (OpenVPN) for flexible remote access.- Performance Monitoring: Utilize Google Cloud Operations Suite to monitor Compute Engine health. Identify bottlenecks and tune instances for peak performance.- Resource Management: Oversee persistent disks, snapshots, and storage buckets. Ensure high availability while purging unused resources to maintain environment hygiene.- Cost Optimization: Actively monitor billing dashboards, implement committed use discounts (CUDs), and right-size underutilized instances to maintain a lean budget.- Database Oversight: Provide support for PostgreSQL and Oracle environments, ensuring seamless integration and performance within the GCP ecosystem.- Security & Compliance: Enforce IAM roles and security best practices to protect the project perimeterRequired Qualifications- Certification: Active Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer certification.- Containerization Mastery: Strong expertise with Docker for containerizing applications, managing images, and troubleshooting container runtimes.- Scripting Mastery: High proficiency in Python or Bash for automating routine infrastructure tasks, reporting, and task scheduling.- Networking Expertise: Hands-on experience managing network routing, firewall rules, and site-to-site VPNs using pfSense and CloudConnexa.- Cloud Migration & Project Leadership: Proven experience leading and running application and data migrations from AWS to GCP. This includes the capability to own the end-to-end migration project life cycle and drive solutions.- Compute Engine Mastery: Deep understanding of VM lifecycles, custom machine types, and auto-scaling.- English Proficiency: Advanced English level (B2–C1 or higher)Nice-to-Have- PostgreSQL Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with configuration, optimization, and query tuning.- Oracle Expertise: Experience managing or migrating Oracle database environments.- Data & Analytics: Familiarity with BigQuery.We offer- We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.- Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).- Personal laptop.- Health and wellness package.- Fully remote.As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

title: Engenheiro Qa
description:

Somos uma equipe interdisciplinar de profissionais formados nas melhores universidades do país e do exterior, com ampla experiência no mercado e prontos para auxiliar a transformação analítica de grandes marcas. Engenharia de dados, tecnologia, processos e pessoas combinados da melhor maneira para cada necessidade do seu projeto.E aí, curtiu? #VemSerUmHauzerQuem estamos procurando?Estamos procurando um(a) Engenheiro(a) de QA para expandir nossa equipe e construir práticas modernas de qualidade para produtos e aplicações de IA, entregues tanto para clientes quanto para uso interno.Buscamos alguém com perfil hands-on, que goste de um ambiente altamente técnico, com oportunidades reais de aprendizado, e que consiga melhorar os resultados de qualidade por meio de processos pragmáticos e ferramentas modernas, incluindo IA.Responsabilidades:- Definir e liderar a estratégia de testes para produtos internos e de clientes (unit, integration, end-to-end, UI, performance, and regression testing)- Construir e manter suites robustas de automação de UI (ex: Playwright), garantindo estabilidade, seletores confiáveis e execução paralela- Implementar automação de testes em APIs e serviços, validando contratos e integrações- Aplicar práticas modernas de QA baseadas em IA (LLMs), como geração de casos de teste, testes exploratórios assistidos e análise inteligente de falhas- Estabelecer critérios de qualidade (quality gates) em pipelines de CI/CD para garantir testes automatizados consistentes e feedback rápido- Projetar ambientes de teste e estratégias de dados que assegurem repetibilidade e segurança- Criar e manter documentação clara sobre estratégias de teste, padrões de automação e prontidão para releases- Colaborar com equipes de produto e UX para garantir que critérios de aceitação sejam testáveis e alinhados com os resultados do usuário- Apoiar a resposta a incidentes, reproduzindo defeitos, fortalecendo testes de regressão e contribuindo para melhorias- Monitorar e reportar métricas de qualidade para reduzir riscos, melhorar confiabilidade e acelerar entregasPara esta vaga esperamos que você tenha:- Experiência em QA, automação de testes ou engenharia de software com forte atuação em testes- Experiência prática com frameworks de automação de UI (ex: Playwright), incluindo padrões como Page Object e testes cross-browser- Experiência com pelo menos uma linguagem moderna de programação usada para automação de testes- Forte entendimento de estratégias modernas de teste (unit, integration, and end-to-end layers)- Experiência prática aplicando IA em fluxos de QA (ex: testes assistidos por LLM)- Experiência testando funcionalidades com IA (validação de prompts, RAG, uso de ferramentas, estratégias de avaliação)- Experiência integrando testes automatizados em pipelines de CI (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins ou similares)- Familiaridade com ferramentas de observabilidade e logs para diagnosticar problemas e reduzir testes instáveis (flaky)- Mindset voltada à segurança no manuseio de dados de teste e controles de acesso- Boa comunicação com públicos técnicos e não técnicos- Capacidade de trabalhar com autonomia em ambiente dinâmico de startup- Proficiência em inglêsAlém disso, consideramos como diferenciais para esta vaga:- Experiência testando pipelines de dados e integrações complexas- Experiência com sistemas distribuídos e arquiteturas modernas- Capacidade de construir ou evoluir processos de QA do zero- Fortes habilidades organizacionais e de pensamento críticoPara se destacar:· Experiência avançada com Playwright ou frameworks similares· Forte experiência com CI/CD e práticas modernas de engenharia de qualidade· Experiência com produtos baseados em IA/ML· Experiência com observabilidade e debugging de sistemas complexos· Familiaridade com governança de dados e complianceTipo de contratação:✅ Regime CLT ou PJ✅100% RemotoBenefícios como CLT:- Cartão de benefícios flexíveis Flash (alimentação/refeição);

title: Specialist Ai Engineer / Builder (Llm & Healthcare) | 100% Remoto
description:
O DESAFIO:A cada ano, o setor de saúde perde bilhões por falhas no faturamento. Nós somos o elo perdido que resolve esse gap com IA. Estamos em plena expansão, com operações reais, clientes ativos e novos parceiros no pipeline. Buscamos um Builder para transformar nosso produto atual em uma plataforma de escala global.POR QUE ESTA POSIÇÃO É PARA VOCÊ?Aqui, autonomia, responsabilidade e protagonismo são nossa vivência diária. Não buscamos pessoas prontas;
não saber tudo faz parte do processo. O que valorizamos é a curiosidade investigativa e o desejo genuíno de aprender.Você atuará do operacional ao estratégico: da mão no código à tomada de decisão. É o perfil que propõe novos modelos e identifica oportunidades de receita, mas que também valida dados manualmente para garantir que a solução seja impecável. Atitude, velocidade e senso de urgência são os motores que impulsionam nossa entrega.PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:Sua missão é liderar a transição tecnológica da nossa inteligência:- O Agora (Execução e Precisão):- Refinar e otimizar modelos em produção (AWS Bedrock), elevando constantemente os níveis de acurácia e performance.- Garantir precisão absoluta "batendo" dados e regras manualmente;
em saúde, a qualidade do dado é inegociável.- Monitorar padrões de negativas (denials) e implementar loops de correção imediatos para que o sistema aprenda em tempo real.- O Futuro (Escala e Arquitetura):- Evoluir nossa infraestrutura para um ecossistema robusto de RAGs e bancos vetoriais.- Migrar de uma solução centralizada para uma malha de modelos especializados por contexto e seguradora.- Contribuir para o fine-tuning de modelos próprios, utilizando nossos dados históricos para criar uma vantagem competitiva única.O QUE BUSCAMOS:- Curiosidade Investigativa: Desejo genuíno de aprender e decifrar as regras complexas do faturamento médico. Você não precisa vir da saúde, mas precisa querer dominá-la.- Atitude e Senso de Urgência: Valorizamos a velocidade e a proatividade. Em nosso contexto de negócio, a capacidade de entrega rápida é vital.- Mão no Código: Experiência prática sólida com Python ou Go e APIs de LLM (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock).- Mentalidade de Builder: Capacidade de construir sistemas robustos do zero e obsessão pelo detalhe (não descansa enquanto a automação não reflete a regra de negócio com precisão cirúrgica).O QUE OFERECEMOS- Oportunidade em Estágio Inicial: Chance de ser um dos primeiros membros de uma empresa em rápida expansão, com impacto direto na arquitetura e cultura.- Desafio Técnico de Alto Nível: Resolver problemas reais usando o estado da arte em IA Generativa.- Equipe de alto nível: você encontrará pessoas fora da curva e nada melhor do que trabalhar com pessoas assim, né?- Flexibilidade e Futuro: Trabalho 100% remoto com possibilidade de participação societária (Equity) para quem constrói o negócio conosco.- Legado: você deixará o seu nome na construção, nos códigos e na história da empresa.

title: Pessoa Estagiária De Sig (Saúde, Segurança E Meio Ambiente)

- Noções básicas de legislação trabalhista e Normas Regulamentadoras (diferencial).Modelo de Trabalho - Estágio - Rotina presencial.Local: Sanca Galpões: Rua Jamil João Zarif, 684 (Box 33 e 34) - Jardim Santa Vicencia, Guarulhos.O que oferecemos:Vale Refeição/Alimentação no Cartão Ifood Benefícios, para você gastar como preferir, no crédito.Vale Transporte: Sem desconto em folha.Plano Médico Sul América Enfermaria: sem custo para você!Plano Odontológico Porto Seguro: Para manter aquele sorriso sempre em dia (cobre até clareamento)!Total Pass ou Wellhub (Opcional): Para você cuidar da saúde física e estar sempre com energia!Seguro de Vida: Para trazer mais segurança e tranquilidade.Frutas 1x por Semana: No seu local de trabalho, para promover hábitos saudáveis.Plano de Carreira: Para quem tem ambição e busca crescimento constante!Por que Barentz?A Barentz é uma ótima empresa para se trabalhar, com uma cultura organizacional positiva e calorosa e uma mentalidade "Uma equipe, um objetivo". title: Account Executive
description:

title: Controlling Supervisor
description:
Role DescriptionThis is a full-time, on-site role for a Controlling Supervisor located in Sorocaba, SP. The Controlling Supervisor will oversee financial planning, cost management, and budgeting processes to ensure operational efficiency. They will analyze financial performance, create detailed financial reports, and provide insights to support decision-making. The role includes collaboration with cross-functional teams, ensuring compliance with company policies, and identifying areas for cost optimization and process improvement. Conduct financial planning (annual and monthly budget vs. actual), in accordance with the parent company's calendar and guidelines, consolidating information from various areas and preparing financial analyses and statements to support senior management in decision-making;
Perform CAPEX analyses (budgeted vs. actual), monitoring deviations and opportunities for optimization;
Ensure the planning andcontrol of working capital, through the projection of revenues, costs, expenses, payroll, accounts receivable and payable, inventories and taxes, identifying financial needs and opportunities;
Prepare monthly resultsbudget and Balance Sheet, with critical analysis and consolidation of systemic data and data from other areas, supporting preventive and improvement actions;
Monitor the results of cyclical inventories, both internal and external, ensuring adequate financial impact;
Monitor and auditcompany materials held by suppliers, performing physical vs. system reconciliations and ensuring the accuracy of balances;
Perform monthly P&L closing, analyzing revenues, costs, operating expenses, freight, payroll, and extraordinary variations, in accordance with internal rules and procedures;
Update financial and operational databases (volumes, prices, average costs, risks, and opportunities), contributing to the predictability of monthly and annual results;
Prepare and report financial and management indicators to the plant and headquarters, through systems, reports, and executive presentations;
Prepare and update management presentations and strategic reports;
Attend to internal and external audits, providing information, analysis, and evidence;
Provide technicalsupport to area employees, guiding and clarifying doubts related to controllership processes;
Perform other related activities inherent to the position, as directed by the immediate supervisor.Assess the impacts of exchange rate variations, mapping exchange rate exposure based on imported items and performing scenario simulations;
- Prepare monthly results budget and Balance Sheet, with critical analysis and consolidation of systemic data and data from other areas, supporting preventive and improvement actions;

title: Analista De Automação De Processos Pleno
description:
**You're here because something else has been letting you down.** A trainee program that doesn't actually grow you. A BigCo that promises fast growth and takes 5 years. A consulting firm where all you see is PowerPoint. A startup that's really just a BigCo with beer on Fridays. You want something else. Something you build yourself. We have that. --- ### Who we are Sofira is an AI-first legaltech. We create AI agents that automate repetitive corporate legal work. The legal industry in Brazil is broken. Large enterprises spend millions on legal claims every year. Our mission is to apply artificial intelligence to solve real pain points, bringing efficiency and scale to complex operations. --- ### The role: Founder's Associate You will work directly with the CEO to **build and automate processes, define strategy, and stand up new areas of the company from scratch** -- whatever is most important and most urgent in that week. In practice, this means your week-to-week looks wildly different: - One week you're 100% focused on fundraising: researching investors, building the deck, sharpening the strategy.
- The next week you're building an automation bot that sources candidates for our next hire.
- The next week you're standing up our commercial machine from zero: ICP, lead lists, cadences, CRM.
- Sometimes you're doing all three in the same week. The common thread: you figure out what matters most, execute, and ask for help when stuck -- you don't suffer in silence. --- ### Your first 30 days - **Week 1:** understand everything about Sofira -- product, customers, market, strategy, team. By the end of the week you can explain us in 60 seconds to a stranger.
- **Week 2:** map everything that can be automated. Surface the 5 highest-leverage automations we should build.
- **Week 3:** build the commercial machine from scratch -- ICP, lead sourcing, cadences, CRM, outbound sequences.
- **Week 4:** start generating your own demands. You see what needs to be built next and you propose it. By month 12, you've touched commercial, recruitment, fundraising, operations, and probably 1-2 things we haven't even planned for yet. --- ### What you get (beyond salary) **Absurdly fast learning.** You'll learn in 12 months what takes 5 years at a corporate. No exaggeration. **Proximity to senior founders.** You'll be in every meeting the CEO is. You'll see product decisions happen. You'll see investor pitches happen. You'll see enterprise contracts being negotiated in real time. **Premium AI tools on us.** ChatGPT Plus, Claude Max, Cursor, Gemini, Perplexity Pro -- whatever helps you move faster, paid by the company. --- ### Where this role can take you In 18-24 months, depending on how you perform, you'll have 3 open paths: - **Head of an area you built yourself** (most likely Growth, Operations, or Recruiting) -- you'll have natural seniority because you built the playbook - **Chief of Staff** -- you already know how every department works - **Your own company** -- with what you learn here, you'll be ready to start your own thing, if that's your dream. --- ### Who we're looking for You: - Are in your **last year of college** or **up to 2 years post-graduation**- Are in **Engineering (any), Economics, Business Administration, Accounting, Computer Science, or a similar analytical field**- Come from a **strong university** (Insper, ESPM, FGV, USP, Unicamp, ITA, PUC-RJ/SP, IBMEC, Mackenzie, Federal Universities, or equivalent)- **Built something real during college** -- inside an empresa junior, entrepreneurship league, AIESEC, a side project, a startup, or a student organization. We care less about the title on your resume and more about the output: something that existed because you made it exist. And also: - **You get shit done.** Give you a task with no time, no budget, and no idea how to do it -- you still deliver. You're the person people call when everything's on fire and someone needs to fix it. You squeeze blood from stones.
- **You hate doing by hand what could be automated.** You're allergic to inefficiency. When you catch yourself doing the same task twice, you start plotting how to kill the third time -- with AI, a script, a no-code tool, anything. Manual work that a robot could do makes you twitch.
- **You fall into rabbit holes.** When a topic grabs you, you disappear into it. You've spent an entire weekend learning why airplane windows have a tiny hole, how submarines stay underwater, or something equally random -- just because you couldn't let go. You're self-taught by default. Nobody has to tell you to go learn something.
- **You run multiple things in parallel -- and you like it that way.** Being locked onto one single focus for 6 months would bore you to death. You get energy from context-switching, not tired from it.
- **You want to be great. Yesterday.** Whether that means running your own company one day, being the best at what you do, or leading a team -- you're not willing to wait 5 years to see yourself there. You feel the urgency.
- **You're tech and AI first.** You didn't major in Computer Science, but you speak tech fluently. You prompt well. You read docs. You're comfortable with tools, APIs, and automations even if you don't build them from scratch. If something is possible with code or AI, you know it's possible -- and you'll figure out how. You've probably already turned down a "stable" and predictable offer because you know it's not for you. --- ### The honest deal We work a lot. This is not a 9-to-5 job. We're building something from zero on top of a R$140 billion market that hasn't seen real innovation in 20 years. That takes everything we have. In return we give: - **Competitive PJ salary.**- **Real ownership of what we build.** We dream big, and we want everyone who builds it alongside us to come along for the ride. You'll own a real piece of the company -- yours to earn as you grow with us. --- ### This is NOT for you if - You need someone to tell you exactly what to do every day - You prefer stable, predictable environments with well-defined processes - You want to be a specialist in one thing - You feel uncomfortable when you don't know something yet - You want an impressive title more than real impact - You don't tolerate working on multiple fronts at the same time - You expect promotions based on tenure If you read this far and felt uncomfortable with any of these points -- respect the discomfort. Don't apply. --- ### How to apply Apply and send me (Priscila Holanda) a DM answering this one question: **"Tell me about the time you most successfully hacked some (non-computer) system to your advantage."** Be specific. We want the actual story.

title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack - Sênior
description: Job Title: React Developer Duration : 5-month contract (until September 2026) Location: Remote (US East Coast working hours) Qualifications: - 3+ years of professional experience as a Front-End Developer - Strong JavaScript expertise, including ReactJS, HTML, and CSS, with a focus on refactoring and component modifications - Experience with JavaServer Pages (JSP) for developing server-side components and supporting legacy UI development Overview: You’ll work in a swarm model, focusing the team on one priority product at a time to deliver measurable ADA/WCAG accessibility improvements before moving on to the next. This is a fully front-end role, where you’ll develop and refine ReactJS, HTML, and CSS components, ensure compliance with accessibility standards, and support legacy UI by working with JSPs or similar technologies. You’ll collaborate closely with product, UX, and engineering teams to implement pre written accessibility requirements, validate outcomes against VPAT, and document improvements. ITTConnect is seeking an NOC / Infrastructure Engineer to work remotely from anywhere in Brazil for a client in the US. MUST BE fluent in English. This role focuses on resolving technical issues, supporting backend infrastructure systems, and collaborating with customer IT teams to deploy and maintain solutions. Infrastructure Engineers combine technical troubleshooting with proactive monitoring and documentation to ensure stable and secure client environments. Serve as an escalation point for the IT Support team on complex infrastructure-related incidents. Maintain strong communication with internal teams and customers regarding issue status and resolution timelines. Requirements 8+ years of IT experience. MUST BE fluent in English. 3–6 years of experience supporting IT infrastructure in an MSP, enterprise IT, or hosting environment. Experience with Windows or Linux server administration. Experience with virtualization platforms (VMware, Hyper-V, etc.). Familiarity with storage, backup, and disaster recovery systems. Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills. Experience working within ticketing systems and following structured support processes. Strong documentation and communication skills. Preferred Certifications such as VMware VCP, Microsoft, or cloud infrastructure certifications. Experience working in a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment with exposure to ITIL-based service delivery models. Experience with enterprise infrastructure technologies including VMware vSphere, Cisco UCS, and Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (CVAD). Cloud platform administration experience;
Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Amazon Web Services (AWS) are preferred. Experience with cloud platforms, particularly Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including infrastructure design, administration, and troubleshooting. Administration experience with Cisco Unified Communications Manager (CUCM), and enterprise storage platforms. title: Virtual Executive Assistant - Family Owned Business Group

Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets), Zapier, Zoom, and project management platforms Strong organizational skills with experience managing complex schedules and competing priorities Proven track record of maintaining strict confidentiality and exercising sound judgment with sensitive information Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated home office setup Availability to work during overlapping U.S. bookkeeping Experience coordinating events, travel, or live productions Comfort working in both clinical / professional and creative / entertainment environments Bilingual capabilities (Spanish is a plus but not required) Experience with Notion, Hubspot and Zapier What We Offer Competitive compensation commensurate with experience Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership across healthcare, luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment Exposure to a diversified business portfolio, not a single company role Flexible, remote-first work environment with an emphasis on results over hours Long-term growth potential for the right candidate who becomes a trusted operational partner

title: Noc Infrastructure Engineer
description:
ITTConnect is seeking an NOC / Infrastructure Engineer to work remotely from anywhere in Brazil for a client in the US. MUST BE fluent in English. The Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for supporting and maintaining customer IT infrastructure within the Managed Services environment. This role focuses on resolving technical issues, supporting backend infrastructure systems, and collaborating with customer IT teams to deploy and maintain solutions. Infrastructure Engineers combine technical troubleshooting with proactive monitoring and documentation to ensure stable and secure client environments. Key Responsibilities Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to servers, virtualization, storage, and core infrastructure systems. Serve as an escalation point for the IT Support team on complex infrastructure-related incidents. Work directly with customers and their IT teams to support the deployment, configuration, and maintenance of infrastructure solutions. Investigate alerts and system reports to proactively identify potential infrastructure issues and performance risks. Follow established runbooks, procedures, and architectural documentation to resolve incidents. Exercise sound technical judgment when diagnosing and resolving infrastructure issues that may not have predefined solutions. Assist with the creation and maintenance of runbooks, diagrams, and infrastructure documentation. Participate in system maintenance activities such as upgrades, patching, and system health checks. Document incident resolution steps and system changes within internal ticketing and knowledge management systems. Maintain strong communication with internal teams and customers regarding issue status and resolution timelines. Requirements 8+ years of IT experience. MUST BE fluent in English. 3–6 years of experience supporting IT infrastructure in an MSP, enterprise IT, or hosting environment. Experience with Windows or Linux server administration. Experience with virtualization platforms (VMware, Hyper-V, etc.). Familiarity with storage, backup, and disaster recovery systems. Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills. Experience working within ticketing systems and following structured support processes. Strong documentation and communication skills. Preferred Certifications such as VMware VCP, Microsoft, or cloud infrastructure certifications. Experience working in a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment with exposure to ITIL-based service delivery models. Experience with enterprise infrastructure technologies including VMware vSphere, Cisco UCS, and Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (CVAD). Cloud platform administration experience;
Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Amazon Web Services (AWS) are preferred. Experience with cloud platforms, particularly Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including infrastructure design, administration, and troubleshooting. Administration experience with Cisco Unified Communications Manager (CUCM), and enterprise storage platforms. Familiarity with identity platforms (Active Directory, Okta), firewalls (Palo Alto, Cisco FTD), and backup/disaster recovery solutions is a plus.

title: Analista De Contabilidade Sênior
description: About Us Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class. Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner. As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space. Key Responsibilities Oversee daily liquidity positioning in both BRL and digital assets, ensuring the firm meets all operational and regulatory obligations. Maintain rigorous oversight of treasury-related accounting entries, ensuring accuracy in the general ledger and alignment with local Brazilian accounting standards. Maintain accounting practices in strict accordance with the Accounting Standard for Institutions Regulated by the Central Bank of Brazil (COSIF), ensuring all financial statements are audit-ready. Lead the preparation and timely submission of CADOC (Central Bank of Brazil Data Collection) reports, ensuring all financial data transmitted to regulators is accurate and consistent. Implement and monitor ACAM frameworks to ensure the Brazilian entity remains within the risk appetite defined by the Central Bank and global HQ. Develop and execute strategies to minimize idle cash, manage currency exposure (FX), and optimize transaction costs across local banking partners. Act as the primary point of contact for local banking partners and regulatory bodies regarding treasury operations, audits, and financial inquiries. Monitor market volatility and counterparty risk, implementing hedging strategies where necessary to protect the firm’s balance sheet. Requirements Experience: Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in Treasury, Corporate Finance, or Financial Operations, preferably within a Fintech, Bank, or Crypto-related institution. Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of Central Bank of Brazil (BCB) regulations. Hands-on experience with CADOC reporting and ACAM risk management guidelines. Strong background in Accounting (IFRS/CPC) and financial statement analysis. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Economics, Finance, or a related field. Professional certifications (e.G., CRC, CFA, or specialized Treasury certifications) are a significant plus. Language Skills: Fluency in English and Portuguese is mandatory, as you will collaborate with global teams and local regulators. Crypto Proficiency: Familiarity with blockchain technology, wallet management, including understanding of blockchain custody, proof of reserves methodologies, and the specific dynamics of the VASP market in Brazil.

title: Analista De Automação De Processos Pleno
description:
**You're here because something else has been letting you down.** A trainee program that doesn't actually grow you. A BigCo that promises fast growth and takes 5 years. A consulting firm where all you see is PowerPoint. A startup that's really just a BigCo with beer on Fridays. You want something else. Something you build yourself. We have that.
--- ### Who we are Sofira is an AI-first legaltech. We create AI agents that automate repetitive corporate legal work. The legal industry in Brazil is broken. Large enterprises spend millions on legal claims every year. Our mission is to apply artificial intelligence to solve real pain points, bringing efficiency and scale to complex operations.
--- ### The role: Founder's Associate You will work directly with the CEO to **build and automate processes, define strategy, and stand up new areas of the company from scratch** -- whatever is most important and most urgent in that week. In practice, this means your week-to-week looks wildly different: - One week you're 100% focused on fundraising: researching investors, building the deck, sharpening the strategy.
- The next week you're building an automation bot that sources candidates for our next hire.
- The next week you're standing up our commercial machine from zero: ICP, lead lists, cadences, CRM.
- Sometimes you're doing all three in the same week. The common thread: you figure out what matters most, execute, and ask for help when stuck -- you don't suffer in silence.
--- ### Your first 30 days - **Week 1:** understand everything about Sofira -- product, customers, market, strategy, team. By the end of the week you can explain us in 60 seconds to a stranger.
- **Week 2:** map everything that can be automated. Surface the 5 highest-leverage automations we should build.
- **Week 3:** build the commercial machine from scratch -- ICP, lead sourcing, cadences, CRM, outbound sequences.
- **Week 4:** start generating your own demands. You see what needs to be built next and you propose it. By month 12, you've touched commercial, recruitment, fundraising, operations, and probably 1-2 things we haven't even planned for yet.
--- ### What you get (beyond salary) **Absurdly fast learning.** You'll learn in 12 months what takes 5 years at a corporate. No exaggeration. **Proximity to senior founders.** You'll be in every meeting the CEO is. You'll see product decisions happen. You'll see investor pitches happen. You'll see enterprise contracts being negotiated in real time. **Premium AI tools on us.** ChatGPT Plus, Claude Max, Cursor, Gemini, Perplexity Pro -- whatever helps you move faster, paid by the company.
--- ### Where this role can take you In 18-24 months, depending on how you perform, you'll have 3 open paths: - **Head of an area you built yourself** (most likely Growth, Operations, or Recruiting) -- you'll have natural seniority because you built the playbook - **Chief of Staff** -- you already know how every department works - **Your own company** -- with what you learn here, you'll be ready to start your own thing, if that's your dream.
--- ### Who we're looking for You: - Are in your **last year of college** or **up to 2 years post-graduation** - Are in **Engineering (any), Economics, Business Administration, Accounting, Computer Science, or a similar analytical field** - Come from a **strong university** (Insper, ESPM, FGV, USP, Unicamp, ITA, PUC-RJ/SP, IBMEC, Mackenzie, Federal Universities, or equivalent) - **Built something real during college** -- inside an empresa junior, entrepreneurship league, AIESEC, a side project, a startup, or a student organization. We care less about the title on your resume and more about the output: something that existed because you made it exist. And also: - **You get shit done.** Give you a task with no time, no budget, and no idea how to do it -- you still deliver. You're the person people call when everything's on fire and someone needs to fix it. You squeeze blood from stones.
- **You hate doing by hand what could be automated.** You're allergic to inefficiency. When you catch yourself doing the same task twice, you start plotting how to kill the third time -- with AI, a script, a no-code tool, anything. Manual work that a robot could do makes you twitch.
- **You fall into rabbit holes.** When a topic grabs you, you disappear into it. You've spent an entire weekend learning why airplane windows have a tiny hole, how submarines stay underwater, or something equally random -- just because you couldn't let go. You're self-taught by default. Nobody has to tell you to go learn something.
- **You run multiple things in parallel -- and you like it that way.** Being locked onto one single focus for 6 months would bore you to death. You get energy from context-switching, not tired from it.
- **You want to be great. Yesterday.** Whether that means running your own company one day, being the best at what you do, or leading a team -- you're not willing to wait 5 years to see yourself there. You feel the urgency.
- **You're tech and AI first.** You didn't major in Computer Science, but you speak tech fluently. You prompt well. You read docs. You're comfortable with tools, APIs, and automations even if you don't build them from scratch. If something is possible with code or AI, you know it's possible -- and you'll figure out how. You've probably already turned down a\ "stable\" and predictable offer because you know it's not for you.
--- ### The honest deal We work a lot. This is not a 9-to-5 job. We're building something from zero on top of a R$140 billion market that hasn't seen real innovation in 20 years. That takes everything we have. In return we give: - **Competitive PJ salary.** - **Real ownership of what we build.** We dream big, and we want everyone who builds it alongside us to come along for the ride. You'll own a real piece of the company -- yours to earn as you grow with us.
--- ### This is NOT for you if - You need someone to tell you exactly what to do every day - You prefer stable, predictable environments with well-defined processes - You want to be a specialist in one thing - You feel uncomfortable when you don't know something yet - You want an impressive title more than real impact - You don't tolerate working on multiple fronts at the same time - You expect promotions based on tenure If you read this far and felt uncomfortable with any of these points -- respect the discomfort. Don't apply.
--- ### How to apply Apply and send me (Priscila Holanda) a DM answering this one question: **\ "Tell me about the time you most successfully hacked some (non-computer) system to your advantage.\ "** Bespecific. We want theactual story.

title: Analista De Automação De Processos Pleno
description:
**You're here because something else has been letting you down.** A trainee program that doesn't actually grow you. A BigCo that promises fast growth and takes 5 years. A consulting firm where all you see is PowerPoint. A startup that's really just a BigCo with beer on Fridays. You want something else. Something you build yourself. We have that.
--- ### Who we are Sofira is an AI-first legaltech. We create AI agents that automate repetitive corporate legal work. The legal industry in Brazil is broken. Large enterprises spend millions on legal claims every year. Our mission is to apply artificial intelligence to solve real pain points, bringing efficiency and scale to complex operations.
--- ### The role: Founder's Associate You will work directly with the CEO to **build and automate processes, define strategy, and stand up new areas of the company from scratch** -- whatever is most important and most urgent in that week. In practice, this means your week-to-week looks wildly different: - One week you're 100% focused on fundraising: researching investors, building the deck, sharpening the strategy.
- The next week you're building an automation bot that sources candidates for our next hire.
- The next week you're standing up our commercial machine from zero: ICP, lead lists, cadences, CRM.
- Sometimes you're doing all three in the same week. The common thread: you figure out what matters most, execute, and ask for help when stuck -- you don't suffer in silence.
--- ### Your first 30 days - **Week 1:** understand everything about Sofira -- product, customers, market, strategy, team. By the end of the week you can explain us in 60 seconds to a stranger.
- **Week 2:** map everything that can be automated. Surface the 5 highest-leverage automations we should build.
- **Week 3:** build the commercial machine from scratch -- ICP, lead sourcing, cadences, CRM, outbound sequences.
- **Week 4:** start generating your own demands. You see what needs to be built next and you propose it. By month 12, you've touched commercial, recruitment, fundraising, operations, and probably 1-2 things we haven't even planned for yet.
--- ### What you get (beyond salary) **Absurdly fast learning.** You'll learn in 12 months what takes 5 years at a corporate. No exaggeration. **Proximity to senior founders.** You'll be in every meeting the CEO is. You'll see product decisions happen. You'll see investor pitches happen. You'll see enterprise contracts being negotiated in real time. **Premium AI tools on us.** ChatGPT Plus, Claude Max, Cursor, Gemini, Perplexity Pro -- whatever helps you move faster, paid by the company.
--- ### Where this role can take you In 18-24 months, depending on how you perform, you'll have 3 open paths: - **Head of an area you built yourself** (most likely Growth, Operations, or Recruiting) -- you'll have natural seniority because you built the playbook - **Chief of Staff** -- you already know how every department works - **Your own company** -- with what you learn here, you'll be ready to start your own thing, if that's your dream.
--- ### Who we're looking for You: - Are in your **last year of college** or **up to 2 years post-graduation** - Are in **Engineering (any), Economics, Business Administration, Accounting, Computer Science, or a similar analytical field** - Come from a **strong university** (Insper, ESPM, FGV, USP, Unicamp, ITA, PUC-RJ/SP, IBMEC, Mackenzie, Federal Universities, or equivalent) - **Built something real during college** -- inside an empresa junior, entrepreneurship league, AIESEC, a side project, a startup, or a student organization. We care less about the title on your resume and more about the output: something that existed because you made it exist. And also: - **You get shit done.** Give you a task with no time, no budget, and no idea how to do it -- you still deliver. You're the person people call when everything's on fire and someone needs to fix it. You squeeze blood from stones.
- **You hate doing by hand what could be automated.** You're allergic to inefficiency. When you catch yourself doing the same task twice, you start plotting how to kill the third time -- with AI, a script, a no-code tool, anything. Manual work that a robot could do makes you twitch.
- **You fall into rabbit holes.** When a topic grabs you, you disappear into it. You've spent an entire weekend learning why airplane windows have a tiny hole, how submarines stay underwater, or something equally random -- just because you couldn't let go. You're self-taught by default. Nobody has to tell you to go learn something.
- **You run multiple things in parallel -- and you like it that way.** Being locked onto one single focus for 6 months would bore you to death. You get energy from context-switching, not tired from it.
- **You want to be great. Yesterday.** Whether that means running your own company one day, being the best at what you do, or leading a team -- you're not willing to wait 5 years to see yourself there. You feel the urgency.
- **You're tech and AI first.** You didn't major in Computer Science, but you speak tech fluently. You prompt well. You read docs. You're comfortable with tools, APIs, and automations even if you don't build them from scratch. If something is possible with code or AI, you know it's possible -- and you'll figure out how. You've probably already turned down a\ "stable\" and predictable offer because you know it's not for you.
--- ### The honest deal We work a lot. This is not a 9-to-5 job. We're building something from zero on top of a R$140 billion market that hasn't seen real innovation in 20 years. That takes everything we have. In return we give: - **Competitive PJ salary.** - **Real ownership of what we build.** We dream big, and we want everyone who builds it alongside us to come along for the ride. You'll own a real piece of the company -- yours to earn as you grow with us.
--- ### This is NOT for you if - You need someone to tell you exactly what to do every day - You prefer stable, predictable environments with well-defined processes - You want to be a specialist in one thing - You feel uncomfortable when you don't know something yet - You want an impressive title more than real impact - You don't tolerate working on multiple fronts at the same time - You expect promotions based on tenure If you read this far and felt uncomfortable with any of these points -- respect the discomfort. Don't apply.
--- ### How to apply Apply and send me (Priscila Holanda) a DM answering this one question: **\ "Tell me about the time you most successfully hacked some (non-computer) system to your advantage.\ "** Bespecific. We want theactual story.

title: Tech Lead Java
description:
Tech Lead JavaA jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui. Sobre a RethinkSomos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado. Diversidade e InclusãoPara repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência.Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente? Qual será o seu papel?Você atuará como principal referência técnica de TI para o time e para o cliente, sendo responsável por garantir a qualidade das entregas, a evolução técnica da equipe e um ambiente colaborativo alinhado à cultura. Além disso, terá um papel ativo na gestão das entregas, acompanhando o andamento das atividades, identificando riscos e garantindo que os compromissos assumidos sejam cumpridos com qualidade. Também contribuirá com decisões de arquitetura e direcionamento técnico, apoiando o time na construção de soluções robustas, escaláveis e alinhadas às boas práticas. Por fim, será responsável por desenvolver o time, atuando com mentoria, feedbacks técnicos e nivelamento de conhecimento.Como será seu dia a dia?Alinhar objetivos do time e assegurar a execução dos processos internos;
Acompanhar dinâmicas deequipes ágeis, facilitando a comunicação e desbloqueando obstáculos;
Apoiar o time de projetos na criação de cronogramas e estimativas;
Realizar entrevistas técnica para novos membros e definir perfis necessários junto à coordenação;
Assegurar que as ferramentas de trabalho (JIRA, documentação) estejam atualizadas;
Resolver conflitos e manter um ambiente colaborativo, positivo e focado em resultados.Para esta vaga, é essencial:Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento backend com Java, com atuação consistente em ambientes de produção e entendimento do ciclo completo de desenvolvimento (do desenho à sustentação);
Domínio de Spring Boot,incluindo construção de APIs, segurança, persistência de dados e organização de aplicações escaláveis e de fácil manutenção;
Conhecimento prático embancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL, com capacidade de modelagem, escrita de queries eficientes e entendimento de performance e uso adequado de cada tecnologia;
Vivência com AWS, compreendendo o uso de serviços como EC2, S3, RDS e Lambda no contexto de aplicações reais, incluindo deploy, configuração e monitoramento básico;
Experiência comcontainers (Docker e/ou Kubernetes), entendendo o ciclo de vida das aplicações e sua execução em ambientes containerizados;
Experiência na construção e integração de APIs RESTful, seguindo boas práticas de design, versionamento e segurança;
Familiaridade com controle de versão utilizando Git, incluindo colaboração em equipe, code review e organização de branches;
Experiência comtestes unitários, garantindo qualidade e confiabilidade do código entregue;
Vivência atuando como referência técnica ou liderança de times, apoiando decisões, direcionando soluções e contribuindo com a evolução técnica da equipe;
Capacidade analítica, autonomia, proatividade e segurança na tomada de decisão em cenários de pressão ou ambiguidade.Você pode se destacar se:Possuir experiência com práticas de DevOps e construção de pipelines de CI/CD;
Tiver vivência com desenvolvimento de arquiteturas resilientes e escaláveis;
Tiver conhecimento em ferramentas de busca e monitoramento, como ElasticSearch. Curtiu a oportunidade?Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Controlling Supervisor
description:
Role DescriptionThis is a full-time, on-site role for a Controlling Supervisor located in Sorocaba, SP. The Controlling Supervisor will oversee financial planning, cost management, and budgeting processes to ensure operational efficiency. They will analyze financial performance, create detailed financial reports, and provide insights to support decision-making. The role includes collaboration with cross-functional teams, ensuring compliance with company policies, and identifying areas for cost optimization and process improvement. Conduct financial planning (annual and monthly budget vs. actual), in accordance with the parent company's calendar and guidelines, consolidating information from various areas and preparing financial analyses and statements to support senior management in decision-making;
Perform CAPEX analyses (budgeted vs. actual), monitoring deviations and opportunities for optimization;
Ensure the planning andcontrol of working capital, through the projection of revenues, costs, expenses, payroll, accounts receivable and payable, inventories and taxes, identifying financial needs and opportunities;
Prepare monthly resultsbudget and Balance Sheet, with critical analysis and consolidation of systemic data and data from other areas, supporting preventive and improvement actions;
Monitor the results of cyclical inventories, both internal and external, ensuring adequate financial impact;
Monitor and auditcompany materials held by suppliers, performing physical vs. system reconciliations and ensuring the accuracy of balances;
Perform monthly P&L closing, analyzing revenues, costs, operating expenses, freight, payroll, and extraordinary variations, in accordance with internal rules and procedures;
Update financial and operational databases (volumes, prices, average costs, risks, and opportunities), contributing to the predictability of monthly and annual results;
Prepare and report financial and management indicators to the plant and headquarters, through systems, reports, and executive presentations;
Prepare and update management presentations and strategic reports;
Attend to internal and external audits, providing information, analysis, and evidence;
Provide technicalsupport to area employees, guiding and clarifying doubts related to controllership processes;
Perform other related activities inherent to the position, as directed by the immediate supervisor.Assess the impacts of exchange rate variations, mapping exchange rate exposure based on imported items and performing scenario simulations;
- Prepare monthly results budget and Balance Sheet, with critical analysis and consolidation of systemic data and data from other areas, supporting preventive and improvement actions;

title: Tech Lead Java
description:

Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência.Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente? Qual será o seu papel?Você atuará como principal referência técnica de TI para o time e para o cliente, sendo responsável por garantir a qualidade das entregas, a evolução técnica da equipe e um ambiente colaborativo alinhado à cultura. Além disso, terá um papel ativo na gestão das entregas, acompanhando o andamento das atividades, identificando riscos e garantindo que os compromissos assumidos sejam cumpridos com qualidade. Também contribuirá com decisões de arquitetura e direcionamento técnico, apoiando o time na construção de soluções robustas, escaláveis e alinhadas às boas práticas. Por fim, será responsável por desenvolver o time, atuando com mentoria, feedbacks técnicos e nivelamento de conhecimento.Como será seu dia a dia?Alinhar objetivos do time e assegurar a execução dos processos internos;
Acompanhar dinâmicas deequipes ágeis, facilitando a comunicação e desbloqueando obstáculos;
Apoiar o time de projetos na criação de cronogramas e estimativas;
Realizar entrevistas técnica para novos membros e definir perfis necessários junto à coordenação;
Assegurar que as ferramentas de trabalho (JIRA, documentação) estejam atualizadas;
Resolver conflitos e manter um ambiente colaborativo, positivo e focado em resultados.Para esta vaga, é essencial:Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento backend com Java, com atuação consistente em ambientes de produção e entendimento do ciclo completo de desenvolvimento (do desenho à sustentação);
Domínio de Spring Boot,incluindo construção de APIs, segurança, persistência de dados e organização de aplicações escaláveis e de fácil manutenção;
Conhecimento prático embancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL, com capacidade de modelagem, escrita de queries eficientes e entendimento de performance e uso adequado de cada tecnologia;
Vivência com AWS, compreendendo o uso de serviços como EC2, S3, RDS e Lambda no contexto de aplicações reais, incluindo deploy, configuração e monitoramento básico;
Experiência comcontainers (Docker e/ou Kubernetes), entendendo o ciclo de vida das aplicações e sua execução em ambientes containerizados;
Experiência na construção e integração de APIs RESTful, seguindo boas práticas de design, versionamento e segurança;
Familiaridade com controle de versão utilizando Git, incluindo colaboração em equipe, code review e organização de branches;
Experiência comtestes unitários, garantindo qualidade e confiabilidade do código entregue;
Vivência atuando como referência técnica ou liderança de times, apoiando decisões, direcionando soluções e contribuindo com a evolução técnica da equipe;
Capacidade analítica, autonomia, proatividade e segurança na tomada de decisão em cenários de pressão ou ambiguidade.Você pode se destacar se:Possuir experiência com práticas de DevOps e construção de pipelines de CI/CD;
Tiver vivência com desenvolvimento de arquiteturas resilientes e escaláveis;
Tiver conhecimento em ferramentas de busca e monitoramento, como ElasticSearch. Curtiu a oportunidade?Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Analista De Automação De Processos Pleno
description:
**You're here because something else has been letting you down.** A trainee program that doesn't actually grow you. A BigCo that promises fast growth and takes 5 years. A consulting firm where all you see is PowerPoint. A startup that's really just a BigCo with beer on Fridays. You want something else. Something you build yourself. We have that. --- ### Who we are Sofira is an AI-first legaltech. We create AI agents that automate repetitive corporate legal work. The legal industry in Brazil is broken. Large enterprises spend millions on legal claims every year. Our mission is to apply artificial intelligence to solve real pain points, bringing efficiency and scale to complex operations. --- ### The role: Founder's Associate You will work directly with the CEO to **build and automate processes, define strategy, and stand up new areas of the company from scratch** -- whatever is most important and most urgent in that week. In practice, this means your week-to-week looks wildly different: - One week you're 100% focused on fundraising: researching investors, building the deck, sharpening the strategy.
- The next week you're building an automation bot that sources candidates for our next hire.
- The next week you're standing up our commercial machine from zero: ICP, lead lists, cadences, CRM.
- Sometimes you're doing all three in the same week. The common thread: you figure out what matters most, execute, and ask for help when stuck -- you don't suffer in silence. --- ### Your first 30 days - **Week 1:** understand everything about Sofira -- product, customers, market, strategy, team. By the end of the week you can explain us in 60 seconds to a stranger.
- **Week 2:** map everything that can be automated. Surface the 5 highest-leverage automations we should build.
- **Week 3:** build the commercial machine from scratch -- ICP, lead sourcing, cadences, CRM, outbound sequences.
- **Week 4:** start generating your own demands. You see what needs to be built next and you propose it. By month 12, you've touched commercial, recruitment, fundraising, operations, and probably 1-2 things we haven't even planned for yet. --- ### What you get (beyond salary) **Absurdly fast learning.** You'll learn in 12 months what takes 5 years at a corporate. No exaggeration. **Proximity to senior founders.** You'll be in every meeting the CEO is. You'll see product decisions happen. You'll see investor pitches happen. You'll see enterprise contracts being negotiated in real time. **Premium AI tools on us.** ChatGPT Plus, Claude Max, Cursor, Gemini, Perplexity Pro -- whatever helps you move faster, paid by the company. --- ### Where this role can take you In 18-24 months, depending on how you perform, you'll have 3 open paths: - **Head of an area you built yourself** (most likely Growth, Operations, or Recruiting) -- you'll have natural seniority because you built the playbook - **Chief of Staff** -- you already know how every department works - **Your own company** -- with what you learn here, you'll be ready to start your own thing, if that's your dream. --- ### Who we're looking for You: - Are in your **last year of college** or **up to 2 years post-graduation**- Are in **Engineering (any), Economics, Business Administration, Accounting, Computer Science, or a similar analytical field**- Come from a **strong university** (Insper, ESPM, FGV, USP, Unicamp, ITA, PUC-RJ/SP, IBMEC, Mackenzie, Federal Universities, or equivalent)- **Built something real during college** -- inside an empresa junior, entrepreneurship league, AIESEC, a side project, a startup, or a student organization. We care less about the title on your resume and more about the output: something that existed because you made it exist. And also: - **You get shit done.** Give you a task with no time, no budget, and no idea how to do it -- you still deliver. You're the person people call when everything's on fire and someone needs to fix it. You squeeze blood from stones.
- **You hate doing by hand what could be automated.** You're allergic to inefficiency. When you catch yourself doing the same task twice, you start plotting how to kill the third time -- with AI, a script, a no-code tool, anything. Manual work that a robot could do makes you twitch.
- **You fall into rabbit holes.** When a topic grabs you, you disappear into it. You've spent an entire weekend learning why airplane windows have a tiny hole, how submarines stay underwater, or something equally random -- just because you couldn't let go. You're self-taught by default. Nobody has to tell you to go learn something.
- **You run multiple things in parallel -- and you like it that way.** Being locked onto one single focus for 6 months would bore you to death. You get energy from context-switching, not tired from it.
- **You want to be great. Yesterday.** Whether that means running your own company one day, being the best at what you do, or leading a team -- you're not willing to wait 5 years to see yourself there. You feel the urgency.
- **You're tech and AI first.** You didn't major in Computer Science, but you speak tech fluently. You prompt well. You read docs. You're comfortable with tools, APIs, and automations even if you don't build them from scratch. If something is possible with code or AI, you know it's possible -- and you'll figure out how. You've probably already turned down a "stable" and predictable offer because you know it's not for you. --- ### The honest deal We work a lot. This is not a 9-to-5 job. We're building something from zero on top of a R$140 billion market that hasn't seen real innovation in 20 years. That takes everything we have. In return we give: - **Competitive PJ salary.**- **Real ownership of what we build.** We dream big, and we want everyone who builds it alongside us to come along for the ride. You'll own a real piece of the company -- yours to earn as you grow with us. --- ### This is NOT for you if - You need someone to tell you exactly what to do every day - You prefer stable, predictable environments with well-defined processes - You want to be a specialist in one thing - You feel uncomfortable when you don't know something yet - You want an impressive title more than real impact - You don't tolerate working on multiple fronts at the same time - You expect promotions based on tenure If you read this far and felt uncomfortable with any of these points -- respect the discomfort. Don't apply. --- ### How to apply Apply and send me (Priscila Holanda) a DM answering this one question: **"Tell me about the time you most successfully hacked some (non-computer) system to your advantage."** Be specific. We want the actual story.

- Vivência com sistemasde gestão como SAP, TOTVS, WMS e TMS;
- Conhecimento em estatística aplicada e formação de KPIs logísticos;

title: Analista de Experiência e Relacionamento com o Cliente
description:
O que você vai fazer (Responsabilidades) Gestão da Jornada do Cliente:
  • Mapear, estruturar e evoluir a jornada completa do cliente, desde o primeiro contato até o pós-evento.
  • Identificar pontos de fricção e oportunidades de melhoria na experiência.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com as áreas de marketing, vendas e produção para garantir uma experiência integrada.
  • Desenvolver iniciativas que elevem o nível de satisfação e encantamento do público.
Customer Experience (CX):
  • Estruturar e monitorar indicadores de experiência do cliente.
  • Implementar e gerir métricas como: NPS (Net Promoter Score); CSAT (Customer Satisfaction Score); CES (Customer Effort Score).
  • Analisar feedbacks, reviews, pesquisas e interações com clientes para gerar insights acionáveis.
  • Liderar projetos de melhoria contínua da experiência.
Customer Success (CS):
  • Desenvolver estratégias de relacionamento e retenção de clientes.
  • Acompanhar indicadores de recompra, fidelização e lifetime value (LTV).
  • Criar ações de relacionamento para clientes recorrentes e VIPs.
  • Garantir acompanhamento próximo de clientes estratégicos e de alto valor.
  • Estruturar processos de acompanhamento e relacionamento com clientes após a compra.
Gestão de CRM:
  • Liderar a estratégia e operação de CRM e relacionamento com a base de clientes.
  • Estruturar segmentações e clusters de público.
  • Planejar e executar réguas de relacionamento e comunicação.
  • Gerir base de dados de clientes e garantir qualidade das informações.
  • Trabalhar com automação de marketing e fluxos de relacionamento
Análise de Dados e Inteligência de Cliente:
  • Transformar dados de clientes em insights estratégicos para marketing, vendas e produto.
  • Criar dashboards e relatórios de performance da área.
  • Acompanhar indicadores como: o taxa de recompra; o churn; o engajamento da base; o conversão de campanhas de CRM; o satisfação do cliente
  • Apoiar decisões estratégicas baseadas em comportamento e dados do consumidor.
  • Operação durante o evento: Atuar junto ao time durante o período do Carnaval para monitorar a experiência do cliente em tempo real. Acompanhar feedbacks e indicadores de satisfação durante o evento.
Como você vai interagir e impactar
  • Colaborar com times de vendas, marketing e produto para alinhar estratégias que promovam a satisfação e fidelização do cliente.
  • Desenvolver processos de feedback contínuo para aprimorar a experiência do cliente e os serviços oferecidos.
  • Conduzir reuniões estratégicas com clientes para fortalecer a parceria e identificar novas oportunidades de negócio.
  • Influenciar a cultura organizacional para foco em customer centricity e melhoria contínua dos processos.
Requisitos:

Esse profissional é responsável por entender as necessidades e dores dos clientes, com intuito de sugerir melhorias, e assegurar que o mesmo chegue ao sucesso desejado dentro da sua empresa. Tem como objetivo avaliar dados e traçar estratégias para aprimorar a experiência do cliente com os produtos ou serviços adquiridos pelo mesmo.

  • Graduação em Administração, Marketing, Comunicação Social, Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Domínio avançado do idioma português, com boa comunicação escrita e verbal.
Competências Técnicas
  • Sólida vivência com CRM , preferencialmente Salesforce , HubSpot ou similares.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de análise de dados e métricas de sucesso do cliente, como Power BI ou Google Analytics .
  • Habilidade no uso de plataformas de automação de marketing e atendimento ao cliente.
  • Capacidade de configurar e gerenciar integrações entre sistemas CRM e outras ferramentas digitais.
Competências Comportamentais
  • Foco no cliente com forte orientação para resultados e resolução de problemas.
  • Comunicação clara e empática para estabelecer parcerias duradouras, com interesse genuíno em criar experiências memoráveis.
  • Proatividade e autonomia para identificar oportunidades de melhoria no relacionamento com clientes.
  • Trabalho colaborativo e adaptabilidade em ambientes dinâmicos.
  • Forte orientação ao cliente e obsessão por experiência.
  • Capacidade analítica e tomada de decisão baseada em dados.
  • Organização e habilidade de estruturar processos.
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade de articulação entre áreas.
  • Visão estratégica aliada à capacidade de execução.
Diferenciais
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis aplicadas ao sucesso do cliente.
  • Conhecimento em estratégias de Customer Success e Customer Experience.
  • Certificações em ferramentas CRM ou gestão de projetos.
  • Capacidade de análise preditiva e uso de inteligência artificial para antecipar necessidades do cliente.
  • Conhecimento intermediário em inglês para leitura e compreensão de materiais técnicos.
  • Experiência em empresas B2C.

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Suprimentos
description:
Descrição da vaga

Aqui na Construtora Tenda , nosso propósito é claro: desafiar o impossível para que mais pessoas conquistem o seu lugar no mundo . Com 56 anos de história, somos uma empresa de capital aberto, presente em 9 estados, com mais de 5mil colaboradores construindo o inimaginável todos os dias. Estamos entre as principais construtoras do Brasil no segmento de habitação econômica, atuando com programa Minha Casa Minha Vida, trazendoinovação, eficiência e foco em moradia digna e acessível.

Aqui, você encontra um ambiente que valoriza o aprendizado constante, o protagonismo e as relações simples e verdadeiras . Trabalhar na Tenda é viver desafios reais, com impacto direto na vida de milhares de famílias e também na sua própria trajetória.

Acreditamos que a diversidade e a inclusão tornam nosso time mais forte. Por isso, todas as nossas vagas também são destinadas a profissionais com deficiência (PcD), reforçando nosso compromisso com um ambiente plural, respeitoso e colaborativo.

Agora queremos te contar mais sobre a vaga de Coordenação na área de Suprimentos e como você pode construir o futuro junto com a gente.

#VemPraTenda

  • Coordenar o processo de compras diretas da cia (compra para as obras) com o apoio da equipe regional e coorporativa, obedecendo as políticas da empresa a fim de buscar o custo mais competitivo para a cia e o bom atendimento as obras;

  • Coordenar a negociação de materiais de obra para garantir a melhor Proposta de acordo com os parâmetros estabelecidos;
  • Coordenar a prospecção de novos fornecedores de serviços e materiais, garantindo que a política da companhia seja mantida;
  • Elaborar os processos de estratégias de melhoria contínua e inovação.
  • Mediar as contratações entre fornecedor externo e cliente interno para garantir produtividade e maior assertividade no processo;
  • Realizar visitas às obras por meio de viagens para acompanhamentos das atividades nos estados que é responsável;
  • Elaborar relatório de report de custos para apresentação à gerência da área;
  • Elaborar relatório de report do fluxo de cronograma de atividades semanal baseado no cronograma de obras viabilizando o início planejado para estas;
  • Elaborar relatório de report de renegociação semanal dos pedidos que excederam o budget na contratação, para apresentação à gerência.

  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia Civil, Arquitetura, Administração ou áreas correlatas;

description:
SUPERVISOR(A) DA QUALIDADE
REQUISITOS DA VAGA

  • Escolaridade: Superior Completo. Formação: Engenharia Mecânica, Metalúrgica, de Petróleo, de Materiais ou de Produção.

  • Idiomas: Inglês avançado obrigatório (leitura, escrita, audição e conversação) a ser avaliado na entrevista.

  • Informática: Pacote Office avançado e vivência com sistemas ERP (SAP, Siemens ou similares).

  • Experiência desejável: mínimo de 05 anos atuando na mesma função, obrigatoriamente em indústria, na liderança de equipes de Controle da Qualidade e de Garantia da Qualidade.


ESPECÍFICOS

  • Larga experiência na implantação, manutenção e melhoria de Sistemas de Gestão Integrados ISO 9001, 14001 e 45001, tendo atuado como auditor líder em SGI conforme a ISO 19011.

  • Vivência na gestão da qualidade de projetos, incluindo análise dos requisitos técnicos e normativos (nacionais e internacionais), emissão de documentos de garantia e de controle da qualidade nas etapas de fabricação, de inspeção e de testes em materiais, componentes semi-acabados e produtos finais.

  • Domínio e aplicação de ferramentas da Qualidade para solução de problemas (A3, 8D Report, 5Why, Diagrama Ishikawa) e da metodologia FMEA para análise preventiva de falhas.

  • Experiência na interação direta com áreas Comercial, Engenharia, Suprimentos e de Produção nas diversas fases do projeto e da fabricação.

  • Atuação direta na interface junto a fornecedores e clientes através de reuniões, visitas, auditorias presenciais de processos e sistemas, incluindo eventos de inspeção, testes e/ou fabricação de produtos.


PRINCIPAIS ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Supervisar as atividades de Controle da Qualidade, incluindo inspeções de recebimento de materiais, inspeção durante a fabricação e testes de aceitação de produtos finais, conforme requisitos técnicos normativos (ABNT, ASTM, ASME, API, ISO), de acordo com planos da qualidade, de inspeção e de testes.

  • Participar das reuniões de projetos, internas (Kick-off meeting) e externas (Pre Inspection/Production Meetings – PIM/PPM) com clientes e fornecedores, planejando as demandas das equipes da Qualidade.

  • Planejar e distribuir as demandas e responsabilidades das equipes de Controle e de Garantia da Qualidade.

  • Liderar as demandas do Sistema de Gestão Integrado, incluindo manutenção e melhoria contínua do SGQ conforme a ISO 9001, certificação e manutenção dos sistemas SGA e SSO nas normas ISO 14001 e ISO 45001.

  • Coordenar no ERP a gestão de documentos, de não conformidades, de riscos e de mudanças, incluindo planos de ação, processos e tratativas no sistema com gestores das áreas interna, fornecedores e clientes.

  • Planejar e acompanhar no ERP os recursos necessários para as inspeções e testes de recebimento de materiais e inspeções e testes nos produtos, conforme programação da fábrica e cronograma dos projetos.

  • Elaborar no ERP planos de controle/garantia da qualidade dos projetos, conforme requisitos dos clientes, incluindo emissão dos certificados de conformidade e aprovação de data book de fabricação dos produtos.

  • Atuar no desenvolvimento de novos fornecedores e no monitoramento da performance dos fornecedores existentes, em conformidade com os requisitos do Sistema de Gestão da Qualidade.

  • Assegurar estrutura adequada para laboratórios, áreas de testes, equipamentos e instalações, conforme requisitos técnicos e de SSMA.

  • Levantar, planejar e coordenar treinamentos conforme demandas da empresa e procedimentos do SGI.

title: Principal Genesys Cloud PS Consultant
description:
Company Description

Miratech helps visionaries change the world. We are a global IT services and consulting company that brings together enterprise and start-up innovation. Today, we support digital transformation for some of the world's largest enterprises. By partnering with both large and small players, we stay at the leading edge of technology, remain nimble even as a global leader, and create technology that helps our clients further enhance their business. We are a values-driven organization and our culture of Relentless Performance has enabled over 99% of Miratech's engagements to succeed by meeting or exceeding our scope, schedule, and/or budget objectives since our inception in 1989. Miratech has coverage across 5 continents and operates in over 25 countries around the world. Miratech retains nearly 1000 full-time professionals, and our annual growth rate exceeds 25%.

Job Description

We are looking for a Principal Genesys Cloud Professional Services Consultant to join our team and drive the delivery of innovative, enterprise-grade contact center solutions.

In this role, you will lead the design and implementation of advanced multi-channel customer experience platforms, leveraging deep expertise in Genesys Cloud and modern contact center technologies.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical leadership, hands‑on delivery experience, and the ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable, high‑quality solutions.

Responsibilities
  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact for customers and internal stakeholders, providing expert consultancy on Genesys Cloud solutions.
  • Lead the design and delivery of end‑to‑end technical solutions, including facilitating workshops, gathering requirements, and producing technical design documentation with stakeholder sign‑off.
  • Analyze complex business and technical challenges to define scalable and effective solution architectures.
  • Own and evolve the technical architecture of Genesys solutions, introducing new technologies and best practices where appropriate.
  • Configure and optimize Genesys Cloud environments to align with changing business and operational needs.
  • Lead the planning and execution of contact center deployments, migrations, and system upgrades.
  • Act as the main escalation and coordination point for Genesys‑related matters, collaborating with internal teams and external vendors.
  • Support production readiness activities and ensure smooth transition of contact center solutions into live environments.
Qualifications
  • 5+ years of hands‑on experience supporting and optimizing large, multi‑site, complex contact center environments.
  • Experience in designing, implementing, and supporting Genesys Cloud solutions in enterprise settings.
  • Proven expertise in building routing strategies and IVR workflows using Genesys Architect
  • Experience with CRM integration (e.g., Salesforce, MS Dynamics) with the Genesys Cloud environment
  • Strong background in infrastructure planning, solution design, deployment, and lifecycle management to ensure high availability and performance.
  • Solid understanding of business processes and their alignment with customer experience technologies.
  • Deep knowledge of SIP infrastructure, including SIP protocol, Session Border Controllers (SBC), and load balancing approaches.
Nice to Have
  • Knowledge of Genesys Cloud Workforce Management (WFM): provide expert guidance and best practices to optimize workforce management processes within the Genesys Cloud environment.
  • Genesys Cloud Training: conduct training sessions for various roles, including supervisors, administrators, users, and architects, to enhance their understanding and effective use of Genesys Cloud features
  • Experience with CX Cloud from Genesys and Salesforce
Additional Information

We offer:

  • Competitive Pay and Benefits: enjoy a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, and a relocation program.
  • Work From Anywhere Culture: make the most of the flexibility that comes with remote work.
  • Growth Mindset: reap the benefits of a range of professional development opportunities, including certification programs, mentorship and talent investment programs, internal mobility and internship opportunities.
  • Global Impact: collaborate on impactful projects for top global clients and shape the future of industries.
  • Welcoming Multicultural Environment: be a part of a dynamic, global team and thrive in an inclusive and supportive work environment with open communication and regular team‑building company social events.
  • Social Sustainability Values: join our sustainable business practices focused on five pillars, including IT education, community empowerment, fair operating practices, environmental sustainability, and gender equality.
